  • AccountInfoDouble · AccountInfoInteger
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getAccountString.

docs.title: ✅ Getting an Account Summary
docs.text:
Request: full account summary (AccountSummaryData) from MT5. Fetch all core account metrics in a single call.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.accountSummary(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: AccountSummary (defined in mt5-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: AccountSummary(AccountSummaryRequest) → AccountSummaryReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.accountSummary(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A single RPC returning full account state: balance, equity, credit, currency, leverage, trade mode, margin / free margin / margin level / margin mode, and server time.
  • Why you need it. Fast dashboard / CLI status; double-check login / currency / leverage; connection heartbeat via getServerTime().
  • Sanity check. If getAccountLogin(), getAccountCurrency(), getAccountLeverage(), getAccountEquity() are set → the connection is alive.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it to display real-time account state and sanity-check connectivity:

  • Dashboard / CLI status in one call.
  • Verify balance & equity before trading.
  • Terminal heartbeat via getServerTime() / getServerTimeUtc() and getServerUtcOffsetSeconds().

Prefer plain values? MT5Service.getAccountSummary() returns a friendly AccountInfo object (named fields, times as numbers) instead of protobuf.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Retrieves full account information in a single call.
  // Returns the raw AccountSummaryData (read fields with getXxx()); throws MrpcError on failure.
  accountSummary(req?: any /* AccountSummaryRequest */): Promise<any /* AccountSummaryData */>;
}

Request message:

AccountSummaryRequest {} (empty message — the argument is optional and defaults to an empty request)

Reply message:

AccountSummaryReply {
  oneof response {
    AccountSummaryData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

MT5Account unwraps the oneof: it resolves with data on success and rejects with MrpcError (carrying the server-side Error) otherwise.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
Parameter Type Description req AccountSummaryRequest (optional) Empty request message. Omit it to use new AccountHelperPb.AccountSummaryRequest().

There is no ctx/timeout parameter. Each call runs on a per-call deadline from the client (callTimeoutMs, default 30000 ms). Tune it on the account:

account.callTimeoutMs = 5000;   // deadline for ordinary read RPCs

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — AccountSummaryData
docs.text:
Field (proto) JS accessor Type Description AccountLogin getAccountLogin() number Trading account login (ID). AccountBalance getAccountBalance() number Balance excluding floating P/L. AccountEquity getAccountEquity() number Equity = balance + floating P/L. AccountUserName getAccountUserName() string Account holder name. AccountLeverage getAccountLeverage() number Leverage (e.g. 100 for 1:100). AccountTradeMode getAccountTradeMode() MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode Demo / Contest / Real — see enum below. AccountCompanyName getAccountCompanyName() string Broker / company display name. AccountCurrency getAccountCurrency() string Deposit currency (e.g. "USD"). ServerTime getServerTime() Timestamp Server time at response (broker time zone). .getSeconds() → unix seconds. ServerTimeUtc getServerTimeUtc() Timestamp The same moment in UTC. UtcTimezoneServerTimeShiftMinutes getUtcTimezoneServerTimeShiftMinutes() number Server offset from UTC (minutes). AccountCredit getAccountCredit() number Credit amount. ServerUtcOffsetSeconds getServerUtcOffsetSeconds() number Broker offset from UTC in seconds (positive = ahead). AccountMargin getAccountMargin() number Margin currently used by open positions. AccountMarginFree getAccountMarginFree() number Free margin available for new positions. AccountMarginLevel getAccountMarginLevel() number Margin level in percent (equity / margin × 100); 0 when no margin is used. AccountMarginMode getAccountMarginMode() MrpcEnumAccountMarginMode Margin mode (MT5 demo = RETAIL_HEDGING) — see enum below. AccountTradeAllowed getAccountTradeAllowed() boolean Trading allowed for this account. AccountTradeExpert getAccountTradeExpert() boolean Automated (EA) trading allowed. TerminalConnected getTerminalConnected() boolean Terminal is connected to the broker. TerminalTradeAllowed getTerminalTradeAllowed() boolean Trading is allowed in the terminal.

🧮 Floating profit: the summary has no dedicated profit field — compute getAccountEquity() - getAccountBalance(), or read accountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_PROFIT).

docs.title: 🧱 Related enums (from proto)
docs.text: 💡 Enum usage note: the generated enums are namespace objects on the *Pb modules. Compare against the full constant, e.g. s.getAccountTradeMode() === AccountHelperPb.MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode.MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO.

docs.title: MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode
docs.text:
enum MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode {
  MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO    = 0;  // demo / practice
  MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_CONTEST = 1;  // contest
  MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_REAL    = 2;  // real trading
}

import { AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const M = AccountHelperPb.MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode;

function tradeModeToString(mode: number): string {
  switch (mode) {
    case M.MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO:    return 'DEMO';
    case M.MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_CONTEST: return 'CONTEST';
    case M.MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_REAL:    return 'REAL';
    default:                                return `UNKNOWN(${mode})`;
  }
}

docs.title: MrpcEnumAccountMarginMode
docs.text:
enum MrpcEnumAccountMarginMode {
  MRPC_ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_RETAIL_NETTING = 0;  // netting (one position per symbol)
  MRPC_ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_EXCHANGE       = 1;  // exchange margin
  MRPC_ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_RETAIL_HEDGING = 2;  // hedging (many positions per symbol) — typical MT5
}

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Errors are exceptions: a server-side rejection rejects with metarpc.MrpcError; a transport failure rejects with the gRPC error. await inside try/catch.
  • Default timeout: read RPCs use callTimeoutMs (default 30000 ms).
  • Timestamps: getServerTime() / getServerTimeUtc() are google.protobuf.Timestamp; read .getSeconds() for unix seconds, or use the friendly MT5Service.getAccountSummary() which returns numbers.
  • Session is automatic: connect() obtains the terminal id and the SDK attaches it to this call — you never pass it yourself.

docs.title: 1) Basic usage
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

async function main() {
  const account = new MT5Account('mt5.mrpc.pro', 443);     // apiKey from MRPC_API_KEY, else TRIAL
  await account.connect({ user: 591129415, password: 'password', server: 'MetaQuotes-Demo' });

  const s = await account.accountSummary();
  console.log('Account Login:', s.getAccountLogin());
  console.log(`Balance: ${s.getAccountBalance().toFixed(2)} ${s.getAccountCurrency()}`);
  console.log('Equity:', s.getAccountEquity().toFixed(2));
  console.log('Leverage: 1:' + s.getAccountLeverage());

  account.close();
}
main().catch(console.error);

docs.title: 2) Compact status line for a CLI
docs.text:
async function printAccountStatus(account: MT5Account) {
  try {
    const s = await account.accountSummary();
    console.log(
      `Acc ${s.getAccountLogin()} | ${s.getAccountCurrency()} | ` +
      `Bal ${s.getAccountBalance().toFixed(2)} | Eq ${s.getAccountEquity().toFixed(2)} | ` +
      `Lev 1:${s.getAccountLeverage()} | Mode ${tradeModeToString(s.getAccountTradeMode())}`
    );
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.log('❌ Error:', e.message);
  }
}
// Output: Acc 591129415 | USD | Bal 10000.00 | Eq 10050.25 | Lev 1:100 | Mode DEMO

docs.title: 3) Floating profit & margin health
docs.text:
async function printHealth(account: MT5Account) {
  const s = await account.accountSummary();
  const floating = s.getAccountEquity() - s.getAccountBalance();   // no dedicated profit field
  const level = s.getAccountMarginLevel();                         // 0 when flat

  console.log('Floating P/L:', floating.toFixed(2));
  if (level === 0)        console.log('No open margin');
  else if (level < 100)   console.log('⚠️ Margin level critical!');
  else if (level < 200)   console.log('⚠️ Low margin level');
  else                    console.log('✅ Healthy margin level');
}

docs.title: 4) Server time with timezone shift
docs.text:
async function printServerTime(account: MT5Account) {
  const s = await account.accountSummary();
  const utc = new Date(s.getServerTimeUtc().getSeconds() * 1000);
  const broker = new Date(s.getServerTime().getSeconds() * 1000);
  console.log('Server time (UTC):', utc.toISOString());
  console.log('Server time (broker):', broker.toISOString());
  console.log('Broker offset from UTC:', s.getServerUtcOffsetSeconds(), 'seconds');
}

docs.title: 5) Structured data model
docs.text:
interface AccountSummaryView {
  login: number; currency: string; balance: number; equity: number;
  floating: number; leverage: number; tradeMode: string; company: string;
}

function fromProto(s: any): AccountSummaryView {
  return {
    login: s.getAccountLogin(), currency: s.getAccountCurrency(),
    balance: s.getAccountBalance(), equity: s.getAccountEquity(),
    floating: s.getAccountEquity() - s.getAccountBalance(),
    leverage: s.getAccountLeverage(), tradeMode: tradeModeToString(s.getAccountTradeMode()),
    company: s.getAccountCompanyName(),
  };
}

const view = fromProto(await account.accountSummary());
console.log(view);

docs.title: 6) Error handling (reconnect is automatic)
docs.text:
async function tryGetSummary(account: MT5Account) {
  try {
    return await account.accountSummary();   // transient errors already retried inside
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.log('Failed to get account summary:', e.message);
    return null;
  }
}

docs.title: Health check
docs.text:
async function isAccountHealthy(account: MT5Account): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const s = await account.accountSummary();
    return s.getAccountLogin() > 0 && s.getAccountCurrency() !== '' && s.getAccountLeverage() > 0;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

docs.title: Monitor account changes
docs.text:
function monitorAccount(account: MT5Account, intervalMs: number) {
  setInterval(async () => {
    try {
      const s = await account.accountSummary();
      console.log(`[${new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 19)}] Balance: ${s.getAccountBalance().toFixed(2)} | Equity: ${s.getAccountEquity().toFixed(2)}`);
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.log('❌ Error:', e.message);
    }
  }, intervalMs);
}
// Usage: monitorAccount(account, 5000);

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• AccountInfoDouble — one double account property (balance, equity, margin, profit…).
  • AccountInfoInteger — one integer account property (login, leverage…).
  • AccountInfoString — one string account property (currency, company, server).
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getAccountSummary() → a named AccountInfo object.

docs.title: MT5Account · Account Information — Overview
docs.text:
Account balance, equity, margin, leverage, currency, trade mode and server time — the complete snapshot in one call, or a single property at a time. Use this page to choose the right API for reading account state.

These methods are read-only. accountSummary lives on mt5_term_api.AccountHelper; the accountInfo* single-property methods on mt5_term_api.AccountInformation. Each resolves with the raw *Data (read fields with getXxx()), or rejects with MrpcError.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• AccountSummary — all account info at once (login, balance, equity, credit, leverage, currency, margin / free margin / margin level / margin mode, server time). Returns the MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode and MrpcEnumAccountMarginMode enums.
  • AccountInfoDouble — a single double property (balance, equity, margin, profit, credit…). Takes an AccountInfoDoublePropertyType.
  • AccountInfoInteger — a single integer property (login, leverage, limit orders…). Takes an AccountInfoIntegerPropertyType.
  • AccountInfoString — a single string property (name, server, currency, company). Takes an AccountInfoStringPropertyType.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• AccountSummary → the one-stop shop for a complete snapshot. One RPC, everything you need for a dashboard, a pre-trade affordability check, or a connection heartbeat.
  • AccountInfoDouble / Integer / String → grab one property when that's all you need — lighter than the full summary. Each takes a property enum selecting which value to read.

Rule of thumb: need the full snapshot → accountSummary; need one specific value → accountInfo*.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Enums used Complete account snapshot (all values) accountSummary AccountSummaryData Output: MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode, MrpcEnumAccountMarginMode One numeric value (balance, equity, margin, …) accountInfoDouble number Input: AccountInfoDoublePropertyType One integer value (login, leverage, …) accountInfoInteger number Input: AccountInfoIntegerPropertyType One text value (currency, company, server, …) accountInfoString string Input: AccountInfoStringPropertyType

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Margin — accountSummary already returns getAccountMargin(), getAccountMarginFree(), getAccountMarginLevel() and getAccountMarginMode(); accountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE / ACCOUNT_MARGIN_LEVEL) is just the single-value alternative.
  • Floating profit — the summary carries no dedicated profit field; compute equity − balance, or read accountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_PROFIT).
  • Currency affects how profit is calculated — always check the account currency.
  • Leverage determines margin requirements — higher leverage, less margin needed.
  • Timeouts — read RPCs use callTimeoutMs (default 30000 ms); tune via account.callTimeoutMs.

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Complete account snapshot
const s = await account.accountSummary();
console.log(
  `Balance: $${s.getAccountBalance().toFixed(2)}, ` +
  `Equity: $${s.getAccountEquity().toFixed(2)}, ` +
  `Leverage: 1:${s.getAccountLeverage()}`,
);

// Single property — account balance
import { AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const D = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType;
const balance = await account.accountInfoDouble(D.ACCOUNT_BALANCE); // returns a number
console.log(`Balance: $${balance.toFixed(2)}`);

// Single integer property — leverage
const I = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoIntegerPropertyType;
const leverage = await account.accountInfoInteger(I.ACCOUNT_LEVERAGE);
console.log(`Leverage: 1:${leverage}`);

// Single string property — currency
const S = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoStringPropertyType;
const currency = await account.accountInfoString(S.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY);
console.log(`Currency: ${currency}`);

// Account-health check — the summary already carries the margin level
const s = await account.accountSummary();
const marginLevel = s.getAccountMarginLevel(); // also getAccountMargin(), getAccountMarginFree()

if (marginLevel > 0 && marginLevel < 100)      console.log('⚠️ Margin level critical!');
else if (marginLevel > 0 && marginLevel < 200) console.log('⚠️ Low margin level');
else                                           console.log('✅ Healthy margin level');

docs.title: 🧱 Enums used in Account Information
docs.text: All four methods use enums — either as an input property selector, or as an output field describing the account. Enums are plain namespace objects on the *Pb modules; use the full constant, e.g. AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType.ACCOUNT_BALANCE.

docs.title: Input enums (property selectors)
docs.text:
Passed to the accountInfo* methods to choose which property to read:

Method Input enum Purpose Example values accountInfoDouble AccountInfoDoublePropertyType which double property ACCOUNT_BALANCE, ACCOUNT_EQUITY, ACCOUNT_MARGIN, ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE, ACCOUNT_MARGIN_LEVEL, ACCOUNT_PROFIT, ACCOUNT_CREDIT, … (14 total) accountInfoInteger AccountInfoIntegerPropertyType which integer property ACCOUNT_LOGIN, ACCOUNT_LEVERAGE, ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE, ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS, ACCOUNT_TRADE_ALLOWED, ACCOUNT_TRADE_EXPERT, ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE, … (11 total) accountInfoString AccountInfoStringPropertyType which string property ACCOUNT_NAME, ACCOUNT_SERVER, ACCOUNT_CURRENCY, ACCOUNT_COMPANY (4 total) 
import { AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const balance  = await account.accountInfoDouble(AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType.ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
const leverage = await account.accountInfoInteger(AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoIntegerPropertyType.ACCOUNT_LEVERAGE);
const currency = await account.accountInfoString(AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoStringPropertyType.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY);

docs.title: Output enums (returned values)
docs.text:
Returned in accountSummary to describe account state:

Method Output enum Accessor Values accountSummary MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode getAccountTradeMode() ..._DEMO (0) · ..._CONTEST (1) · ..._REAL (2) accountSummary MrpcEnumAccountMarginMode getAccountMarginMode() ..._RETAIL_NETTING (0) · ..._EXCHANGE (1) · ..._RETAIL_HEDGING (2, typical MT5) accountInfoInteger returned as a number RequestedValue querying ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE yields 0/1/2 
const s = await account.accountSummary();
const T = AccountInformationPb.MrpcEnumAccountTradeMode;
switch (s.getAccountTradeMode()) {
  case T.MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO: console.log('Demo account'); break;
  case T.MRPC_ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_REAL: console.log('Real account'); break;
}

docs.title: 📝 Notes about enums
docs.text:
• Input enums are required — accountInfo* always needs a property constant.
  • Output enums are typed fields — accountSummary returns getAccountTradeMode() / getAccountMarginMode() directly.
  • accountInfoInteger special case — some integer properties (e.g. ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE) encode an enum, but come back as a plain number (0/1/2), not a typed enum.
  • No enums on Double/String outputs — those always return a plain number / string.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:

  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getAccountSummary() returns a named AccountInfo object (plain fields, UTC times).

Back to: MT5Account — Master Overview

docs.title: 🔎 Checking a Symbol Exists
docs.text:
Request: whether the broker knows a symbol, and whether it's custom (SymbolExistData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolExist(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolExist (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolExist(SymbolExistRequest) → SymbolExistReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolExist(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that reports whether a symbol name is known to the broker, and whether it's a custom symbol.
  • Why you need it. Validate user input before selecting/trading — avoid errors on typos.
  • Sanity check. getExists() is true for "EURUSD" on an FX broker.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Guard trading flows: check a symbol exists before SymbolSelect / OrderSend.
  • Distinguish broker symbols from locally-created custom symbols.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build the request with the symbol name.
  2. Call account.symbolExist(req).
  3. Read getExists() and getIsCustom().
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolExistRequest();
req.setName('EURUSD');
const d = await account.symbolExist(req);
console.log(d.getExists(), d.getIsCustom());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Check a symbol. Pass a built SymbolExistRequest (setName).
  symbolExist(req: any /* SymbolExistRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolExistData */>;
}

Request message: SymbolExistRequest { string name = 1; } — setName(string).

Reply message:

SymbolExistReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolExistData data = 1;   // getExists(): bool, getIsCustom(): bool
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setName(name) string Symbol name to check.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolExistData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description exists getExists() boolean true if the broker knows this symbol. is custom getIsCustom() boolean true if it's a custom (user-created) symbol.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Case & suffix matter. Brokers use suffixes (EURUSD.m, EURUSD.r); if getExists() is false, the exact name may differ — list names via SymbolName/SymbolsTotal.
  • Exists ≠ selected. A symbol can exist but not be in Market Watch — call SymbolSelect before reading live data.
  • Friendly form returns { exists, isCustom }: MT5Service.symbolExist.

docs.title: 1) Basic check
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolExistRequest();
req.setName('EURUSD');
const d = await account.symbolExist(req);
console.log('exists?', d.getExists());

docs.title: 2) Guard before selecting
docs.text:
async function ensureKnown(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<void> {
  const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolExistRequest(); req.setName(sym);
  if (!(await account.symbolExist(req)).getExists()) throw new Error(`unknown symbol ${sym}`);
  await account.symbolSelect(sym, true);
}

docs.title: 3) Custom vs broker symbol
docs.text:
const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolExistRequest(); req.setName('MYINDEX');
const d = await account.symbolExist(req);
console.log(d.getExists() ? (d.getIsCustom() ? 'custom' : 'broker') : 'unknown');

docs.title: 4) Validate a list of symbols
docs.text:
async function filterKnown(account: MT5Account, names: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const n of names) {
    const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolExistRequest(); r.setName(n);
    if ((await account.symbolExist(r)).getExists()) out.push(n);
  }
  return out;
}

docs.title: Boolean helper
docs.text:
function exists(account: MT5Account, name: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolExistRequest(); r.setName(name);
  return account.symbolExist(r).then((d) => d.getExists());
}

docs.text:

  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.symbolExist · MT5Sugar.isSymbolAvailable.

docs.title: 📊 Getting a Double Symbol Property
docs.text:
Request: one floating-point symbol property (SymbolInfoDoubleData → a number) from MT5 — bid, ask, point, tick value/size, contract size, volume limits, swaps, selected by an enum.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolInfoDouble(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolInfoDouble (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolInfoDouble(SymbolInfoDoubleRequest) → SymbolInfoDoubleReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolInfoDouble(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning a single double property of a symbol, chosen by a SymbolInfoDoubleProperty value.
  • Why you need it. Read exactly the number you need — SYMBOL_POINT to size pips, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE for P&L — without pulling the whole SymbolParamsMany.
  • Sanity check. SYMBOL_BID returns a positive price for a selected symbol.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it for one precise contract/price figure:

  • Pip & price math — SYMBOL_POINT, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE.
  • Position sizing & P&L — SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE, SYMBOL_TRADE_CONTRACT_SIZE.
  • Volume rules — SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN / MAX / STEP.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Select the symbol first (account.symbolSelect('EURUSD')) so the broker streams its data.
  2. Build the request with the symbol and the property enum.
  3. Call account.symbolInfoDouble(req) and read getValue().
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setType(MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleProperty.SYMBOL_POINT);
const point = (await account.symbolInfoDouble(req)).getValue();

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Read one SYMBOL_* double property. Pass a built SymbolInfoDoubleRequest.
  symbolInfoDouble(req: any /* SymbolInfoDoubleRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolInfoDoubleData */>;
}

Request message: SymbolInfoDoubleRequest { string symbol = 1; SymbolInfoDoubleProperty type = 2; } — setters setSymbol(string), setType(SymbolInfoDoubleProperty).

Reply message:

SymbolInfoDoubleReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolInfoDoubleData data = 1;   // getValue(): double
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(symbol) string Instrument, e.g. "EURUSD". setType(property) SymbolInfoDoubleProperty Which double property to read.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolInfoDoubleData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description value getValue() number The property's value.

docs.title: 🧱 Related enums (from proto)
docs.text: Access as MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleProperty.SYMBOL_POINT (a number).

docs.title: SymbolInfoDoubleProperty — common values
docs.text: Constant Meaning SYMBOL_BID / SYMBOL_ASK Best bid / ask price. SYMBOL_LAST Last deal price. SYMBOL_POINT Smallest price increment. SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE Minimal price change for a tick. docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Select first. On a symbol not in Market Watch some properties read 0 — call SymbolSelect first, or use SymbolInfoTick/ensureSymbol.
  • Pip size. This SDK treats pip = point × (digits is 3 or 5 ? 10 : 1) — combine SYMBOL_POINT with SymbolInfoInteger SYMBOL_DIGITS.
  • Many at once? Prefer SymbolParamsMany over dozens of single reads.

import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setType(D.SYMBOL_POINT);
const point = (await account.symbolInfoDouble(req)).getValue();

docs.title: 2) Current bid / ask
docs.text:
const D = MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleProperty;
async function price(sym: string, prop: number) {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleRequest();
  r.setSymbol(sym); r.setType(prop);
  return (await account.symbolInfoDouble(r)).getValue();
}
const [bid, ask] = await Promise.all([price('EURUSD', D.SYMBOL_BID), price('EURUSD', D.SYMBOL_ASK)]);
console.log(bid, ask, 'spread', (ask - bid).toFixed(5));

function symbolDouble(account: MT5Account, sym: string, prop: number): Promise<number> {

docs.title: Pip size helper
docs.text:
async function pipSize(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<number> {
  const D = MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleProperty;
  const I = MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerProperty;
  const pReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleRequest(); pReq.setSymbol(sym); pReq.setType(D.SYMBOL_POINT);
  const dReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerRequest(); dReq.setSymbol(sym); dReq.setType(I.SYMBOL_DIGITS);
  const [point, digits] = await Promise.all([
    account.symbolInfoDouble(pReq).then((d) => d.getValue()),
    account.symbolInfoInteger(dReq).then((d) => Number(d.getValue())),
  ]);
  return point * (digits === 3 || digits === 5 ? 10 : 1);
}

docs.title: 🔢 Getting an Integer Symbol Property
docs.text:
Request: one integer symbol property (SymbolInfoIntegerData → a number) from MT5 — digits, spread, stops level, trade mode, visibility, and timing flags, selected by an enum.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolInfoInteger(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolInfoInteger (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolInfoInteger(SymbolInfoIntegerRequest) → SymbolInfoIntegerReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolInfoInteger(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning a single integer/flag property of a symbol, chosen by a SymbolInfoIntegerProperty value.
  • Why you need it. SYMBOL_DIGITS to format prices, SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL to keep SL/TP legal, SYMBOL_SPREAD for cost.
  • Sanity check. SYMBOL_DIGITS returns 5 for EURUSD.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it for a symbol's integer configuration:

  • Formatting — SYMBOL_DIGITS.
  • Order legality — SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL, SYMBOL_TRADE_FREEZE_LEVEL.
  • State — SYMBOL_SELECT, SYMBOL_VISIBLE, SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Select the symbol so its data is available.
  2. Build the request with the symbol and the property enum.
  3. Call account.symbolInfoInteger(req) and read getValue() (coerce with Number(...)).
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setType(MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerProperty.SYMBOL_DIGITS);
const digits = Number((await account.symbolInfoInteger(req)).getValue());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Read one SYMBOL_* integer property. Pass a built SymbolInfoIntegerRequest.
  symbolInfoInteger(req: any /* SymbolInfoIntegerRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolInfoIntegerData */>;
}

Request message: SymbolInfoIntegerRequest { string symbol = 1; SymbolInfoIntegerProperty type = 2; } — setSymbol, setType.

Reply message:

SymbolInfoIntegerReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolInfoIntegerData data = 1;   // getValue(): int64 (and getValueUtc for time props)
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• getValue() is int64. Coerce with Number(...); all symbol integers fit safely.
  • Stops level is key for trading. SL/TP closer than SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL are rejected with retcode 10016 — see Return Codes.
  • Flags are 0/1. Compare === 1 for SYMBOL_SELECT / SYMBOL_VISIBLE / SYMBOL_SPREAD_FLOAT.

docs.title: Legal-stop check before an order
docs.text:
async function stopIsLegal(account: MT5Account, sym: string, distancePoints: number): Promise<boolean> {
  const I = MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerProperty;
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerRequest();
  r.setSymbol(sym); r.setType(I.SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL);
  const min = Number((await account.symbolInfoInteger(r)).getValue());
  return distancePoints >= min;
}

docs.title: 🔤 Getting a String Symbol Property
docs.text:
Request: one text symbol property (SymbolInfoStringData → a string) from MT5 — description, currencies, path, ISIN, exchange, selected by an enum.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolInfoString(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolInfoString (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolInfoString(SymbolInfoStringRequest) → SymbolInfoStringReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolInfoString(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning a single text property of a symbol, chosen by a SymbolInfoStringProperty value.
  • Why you need it. Human-readable SYMBOL_DESCRIPTION, the SYMBOL_CURRENCY_* codes, or the SYMBOL_PATH grouping.
  • Sanity check. SYMBOL_CURRENCY_BASE returns a 3-letter code (e.g. "EUR").

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it for a symbol's textual identity:

  • Display — SYMBOL_DESCRIPTION.
  • Currencies — SYMBOL_CURRENCY_BASE / PROFIT / MARGIN.
  • Organisation — SYMBOL_PATH, SYMBOL_EXCHANGE, SYMBOL_ISIN.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Select the symbol so its data is available.
  2. Build the request with the symbol and the property enum.
  3. Call account.symbolInfoString(req) and read getValue().
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoStringRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setType(MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoStringProperty.SYMBOL_DESCRIPTION);
const desc = (await account.symbolInfoString(req)).getValue();

  // Read one SYMBOL_* string property. Pass a built SymbolInfoStringRequest.
  symbolInfoString(req: any /* SymbolInfoStringRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolInfoStringData */>;
}

Request message: SymbolInfoStringRequest { string symbol = 1; SymbolInfoStringProperty type = 2; } — setSymbol, setType.

Reply message:

SymbolInfoStringReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolInfoStringData data = 1;   // getValue(): string
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: SymbolInfoStringProperty — common values
docs.text: Constant Meaning SYMBOL_DESCRIPTION Human-readable description. SYMBOL_CURRENCY_BASE Base currency. SYMBOL_CURRENCY_PROFIT Profit currency. SYMBOL_CURRENCY_MARGIN Margin currency. SYMBOL_PATH Tree path / grouping. SYMBOL_EXCHANGE Exchange name. SYMBOL_ISIN ISIN code (where available). SYMBOL_BANK / SYMBOL_BASIS Quote source / underlying. SYMBOL_CATEGORY / SYMBOL_SECTOR_NAME / SYMBOL_INDUSTRY_NAME Classification. All 15 SymbolInfoStringProperty string properties (click to expand) Constant Value Description SYMBOL_BASIS 0 Underlying asset of derivative SYMBOL_CATEGORY 1 Symbol category SYMBOL_COUNTRY 2 Country the symbol belongs to SYMBOL_SECTOR_NAME 3 Economic sector name SYMBOL_INDUSTRY_NAME 4 Industry name SYMBOL_CURRENCY_BASE 5 Base currency (first currency in pair) SYMBOL_CURRENCY_PROFIT 6 Profit currency (second currency in pair) SYMBOL_CURRENCY_MARGIN 7 Margin calculation currency SYMBOL_BANK 8 Source of last quote (bank/exchange) SYMBOL_DESCRIPTION 9 Symbol description/full name SYMBOL_EXCHANGE 10 Exchange the symbol is traded on SYMBOL_FORMULA 11 Formula for custom symbol price calculation SYMBOL_ISIN 12 International Securities Identification Number SYMBOL_PAGE 13 Web page URL with symbol information SYMBOL_PATH 14 Symbol path in Market Watch tree

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Currencies pair up. SYMBOL_CURRENCY_BASE + SYMBOL_CURRENCY_PROFIT describe the pair; SYMBOL_CURRENCY_MARGIN is what margin is held in.
  • Some fields are empty for certain symbols (e.g. SYMBOL_ISIN for FX) — expect "".
  • Full spec? SymbolParamsMany returns description, path and currencies together.

docs.title: 💱 Getting the Latest Tick
docs.text:
Request: the current tick of a symbol — bid, ask, last, volume and time (MrpcMqlTick), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolInfoTick(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolInfoTick (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolInfoTick(SymbolInfoTickRequest) → SymbolInfoTickReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolInfoTick(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the latest tick of a symbol as an MrpcMqlTick.
  • Why you need it. The cheapest way to read the current bid/ask without opening a stream.
  • Sanity check. getBid() and getAsk() are positive for a selected, trading symbol.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• A one-shot price read for a decision or a display.
  • Compute spread (ask − bid) and mid ((bid + ask) / 2).
  • Check quote freshness via the tick's time.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Select the symbol so it quotes (SymbolSelect).
  2. Call account.symbolInfoTick(symbol) — the SDK builds the request and returns the raw MrpcMqlTick.
  3. Read getBid() / getAsk() / getTime(); convert the timestamp with getSeconds() * 1000 → Date.
const tick = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
console.log(tick.getBid(), tick.getAsk());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Current tick of a symbol. Plain arg; returns the raw MrpcMqlTick.
  symbolInfoTick(symbol: string, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* MrpcMqlTick */>;
}

Request message: SymbolInfoTickRequest { string symbol = 1; } (built for you).

Reply message:

SymbolInfoTickReply {
  oneof response {
    MrpcMqlTick data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description symbol string Instrument, e.g. "EURUSD".

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — MrpcMqlTick
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description bid getBid() number Best bid price. ask getAsk() number Best ask price. last getLast() number Last deal price. volume getVolume() number Tick volume (integer). volume (real) getVolumeReal() number Real volume. time getTime() Timestamp Tick time (broker tz) — .getSeconds() * 1000 → Date. time (UTC) getTimeUtc() Timestamp Same moment in UTC. time (ms) getTimeMsc() number Milliseconds since epoch. time (ms, UTC) getTimeMscUtc() number Milliseconds since epoch (UTC). flags getFlags() number Tick flags bitmask.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Select first. On an unselected symbol the tick may be empty — SymbolSelect / ensureSymbol.
  • Timestamps. getTime() is a protobuf Timestamp; read .getSeconds(). getTimeMsc() gives milliseconds directly.
  • Need a stream? For continuous updates use OnSymbolTick instead of polling this.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getSymbolTick returns a mapped Quote ({ symbol, bid, ask, last, volume, time (ms), flags }).

docs.title: 1) Basic bid / ask
docs.text:
const tick = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
console.log('bid', tick.getBid(), 'ask', tick.getAsk());

docs.title: 2) Spread and mid price
docs.text:
const t = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
const spread = t.getAsk() - t.getBid();
const mid = (t.getBid() + t.getAsk()) / 2;
console.log({ spread: spread.toFixed(5), mid: mid.toFixed(5) });

docs.title: 3) Tick time as a Date
docs.text:
const t = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
const when = new Date(t.getTime().getSeconds() * 1000);
console.log('quote at', when.toISOString());

docs.title: 4) Quote freshness check
docs.text:
const t = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
const ageMs = Date.now() - t.getTimeMsc();
if (ageMs > 5000) console.warn(`stale quote (${(ageMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s old)`);

docs.title: 5) Spread in pips
docs.text:
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const D = MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleProperty;
const I = MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerProperty;

const t = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
const pReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleRequest(); pReq.setSymbol('EURUSD'); pReq.setType(D.SYMBOL_POINT);
const dReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerRequest(); dReq.setSymbol('EURUSD'); dReq.setType(I.SYMBOL_DIGITS);
const [point, digits] = await Promise.all([
  account.symbolInfoDouble(pReq).then((d) => d.getValue()),
  account.symbolInfoInteger(dReq).then((d) => Number(d.getValue())),
]);
const pip = point * (digits === 3 || digits === 5 ? 10 : 1);
console.log('spread pips:', ((t.getAsk() - t.getBid()) / pip).toFixed(1));

docs.title: 6) Poll a few quotes
docs.text:
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  const t = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
  console.log(t.getBid(), t.getAsk());
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
}

For many updates, prefer the OnSymbolTick stream over a polling loop.

docs.title: Safe price read with select
docs.text:
async function currentPrice(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<{ bid: number; ask: number }> {
  await account.symbolSelect(sym, true);
  const t = await account.symbolInfoTick(sym);
  return { bid: t.getBid(), ask: t.getAsk() };
}

docs.title: Mid-price helper
docs.text:
async function mid(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<number> {
  const t = await account.symbolInfoTick(sym);
  return (t.getBid() + t.getAsk()) / 2;
}

docs.title: 🔄 Checking Symbol Synchronization
docs.text:
Request: whether a symbol's data is synchronized with the server (SymbolIsSynchronizedData → a boolean), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolIsSynchronized(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolIsSynchronized (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolIsSynchronized(SymbolIsSynchronizedRequest) → SymbolIsSynchronizedReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolIsSynchronized(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC reporting whether the terminal has fully synced a symbol's spec and quotes with the server.
  • Why you need it. After SymbolSelect, wait until data is in sync before relying on prices or specs.
  • Sanity check. Returns true for an actively-quoting selected symbol.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Avoid reading stale/zero properties right after selecting a symbol.
  • Gate a quote-dependent action until the symbol is ready.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Select the symbol (SymbolSelect).
  2. Poll account.symbolIsSynchronized(symbol) until it returns true (or use ensureSymbol).
  3. Proceed to read prices / specs.
await account.symbolSelect('EURUSD', true);
while (!(await account.symbolIsSynchronized('EURUSD'))) {
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Is the symbol's data synced? Plain arg; returns a boolean.
  symbolIsSynchronized(symbol: string, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<boolean>;
}

Request message: SymbolIsSynchronizedRequest { string symbol = 1; } (built for you).

Reply message:

SymbolIsSynchronizedReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolIsSynchronizedData data = 1;   // synchronized flag
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description symbol string Instrument to check.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text: Promise<boolean> — true when the symbol is synchronized with the server.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Pair with SymbolSelect. Selecting is instant; syncing can take a moment.
  • Prefer ensureSymbol. MT5Service.ensureSymbol selects and waits for a live quote in one call — simpler than polling this yourself.
  • Don't hot-loop. Add a small delay (e.g. 200 ms) between checks.

docs.title: 1) Basic check
docs.text: console.log('synced?', await account.symbolIsSynchronized('EURUSD'));

docs.title: 2) Wait until synced
docs.text:
async function waitSynced(account: MT5Account, sym: string, timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<boolean> {
  const until = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < until) {
    if (await account.symbolIsSynchronized(sym)) return true;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
  }
  return false;
}

docs.title: 3) Select → wait → read
docs.text:
await account.symbolSelect('EURUSD', true);
if (await waitSynced(account, 'EURUSD')) {
  const tick = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
  console.log(tick.getBid(), tick.getAsk());
}

docs.title: 4) Guard a batch
docs.text:
for (const sym of ['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD']) {
  await account.symbolSelect(sym, true);
  if (!(await waitSynced(account, sym))) console.warn(sym, 'not synced');
}

docs.title: Ready-check helper
docs.text:
async function symbolReady(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<boolean> {
  await account.symbolSelect(sym, true);
  return account.symbolIsSynchronized(sym);
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• SymbolSelect — select before syncing. · SymbolInfoTick
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.isSymbolSynchronized / ensureSymbol.

docs.title: 🏷️ Getting a Symbol Name by Index
docs.text:
Request: the name of the symbol at a given index, over all symbols or just Market Watch (SymbolNameData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolName(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolName (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolName(SymbolNameRequest) → SymbolNameReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolName(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the symbol name at position index, within either the full list or the selected (Market Watch) list.
  • Why you need it. Enumerate symbols together with SymbolsTotal.
  • Sanity check. Index 0 of the selected list returns the first Market Watch symbol.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Build a picker / autocomplete of available instruments.
  • Iterate the Market Watch to snapshot or subscribe to each symbol.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Get the count with SymbolsTotal for the scope you want.
  2. For each index, build a SymbolNameRequest with setIndex and setSelected (same scope).
  3. Call account.symbolName(req) and read getName().
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolNameRequest();
req.setIndex(0);
req.setSelected(true);                 // from Market Watch
const name = (await account.symbolName(req)).getName();

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Name at an index. Pass a built SymbolNameRequest (setIndex, setSelected).
  symbolName(req: any /* SymbolNameRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolNameData */>;
}

Request message: SymbolNameRequest { int32 index = 1; bool selected = 2; } — setIndex(number), setSelected(boolean).

Reply message:

SymbolNameReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolNameData data = 1;   // getName(): string
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setIndex(index) number 0-based position. setSelected(selected) boolean true = index within Market Watch, false = within all symbols.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolNameData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description name getName() string Symbol name at the index.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Keep the scope consistent. Use the same selected flag for SymbolsTotal and the index loop.
  • Out-of-range index yields an error reply (MrpcError) — stop at total − 1.
  • The friendly list MT5Sugar.getAllSymbols returns every name as a string[] in one call.

docs.title: 1) First Market Watch symbol

import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolNameRequest();
req.setIndex(0); req.setSelected(true);

const total = (await account.symbolsTotal(tReq)).getTotal();
for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolNameRequest(); r.setIndex(i); r.setSelected(true);

docs.title: 4) Collect all selected names
docs.text:
async function selectedNames(account: MT5Account): Promise<string[]> {
  const tReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest(); tReq.setMode(true);
  const total = (await account.symbolsTotal(tReq)).getTotal();
  const names: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
    const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolNameRequest(); r.setIndex(i); r.setSelected(true);
    names.push((await account.symbolName(r)).getName());
  }
  return names;
}

docs.text:
function nameAt(account: MT5Account, index: number, selected = true): Promise<string> {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolNameRequest(); r.setIndex(index); r.setSelected(selected);
  return account.symbolName(r).then((d) => d.getName());
}

docs.title: ➕ Selecting a Symbol (Market Watch)
docs.text:
Request: add a symbol to — or remove it from — Market Watch so its live data is available (SymbolSelectData → a boolean), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolSelect(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolSelect (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolSelect(SymbolSelectRequest) → SymbolSelectReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolSelect(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that selects (adds) or deselects (removes) a symbol in Market Watch. The SDK method takes plain arguments and returns a boolean.
  • Why you need it. You must select a symbol before quotes, ticks or most SymbolInfo* reads return live data.
  • Sanity check. Returns true when the selection succeeds.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Prepare a symbol for quotes / ticks / trading.
  • Tidy up by deselecting symbols you no longer watch.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Connect so the SDK has a terminal session.
  2. Call account.symbolSelect(symbol, true) to add it (or false to remove).
  3. The SDK builds the request and returns the resulting boolean.
await account.symbolSelect('EURUSD', true);    // add to Market Watch
// … read ticks / trade …
await account.symbolSelect('EURUSD', false);   // remove when done

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Select (true) or deselect (false) a symbol. Plain args; returns the success boolean.
  symbolSelect(symbol: string, select?: boolean, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<boolean>;
}

Request message: SymbolSelectRequest { string symbol = 1; bool select = 2; } (built for you).

Reply message:

SymbolSelectReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolSelectData data = 1;   // success flag
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description symbol string Instrument, e.g. "EURUSD". select boolean true (default) = add, false = remove.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output
docs.text: Promise<boolean> — true on success. A failure (e.g. unknown symbol) rejects with an MrpcError (ErrMarketSelectError / code 4305 when the broker can't add it).

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Select before reading. Many SymbolInfo* reads return 0/stale until the symbol is selected.
  • Give it a moment. After selecting, the first quote may take a tick to arrive — MT5Service.ensureSymbol selects and waits for a live quote.
  • Validate first. If the name might be wrong, check SymbolExist to avoid a 4305.

docs.title: 1) Add a symbol
docs.text:
const ok = await account.symbolSelect('EURUSD', true);
console.log('selected?', ok);

docs.title: 2) Select, then read a tick
docs.text:
await account.symbolSelect('EURUSD', true);
const tick = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
console.log(tick.getBid(), tick.getAsk());

docs.title: 3) Remove when finished
docs.text: await account.symbolSelect('EURUSD', false);

docs.title: 4) Prepare a basket
docs.text:
for (const sym of ['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'XAUUSD']) {
  await account.symbolSelect(sym, true);
}

docs.title: 5) Guarded select
docs.text:
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
async function safeSelect(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolExistRequest(); r.setName(sym);
  if (!(await account.symbolExist(r)).getExists()) return false;
  return account.symbolSelect(sym, true);
}

docs.title: Ensure selected before trading
docs.text:
async function ensureSelected(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<void> {
  try { await account.symbolSelect(sym, true); }
  catch (e) { throw new Error(`cannot select ${sym}: ${(e as Error).message}`); }
}

docs.text:
• SymbolIsSynchronized — is its data ready? · SymbolInfoTick · SymbolExist
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.symbolSelect / ensureSymbol.

docs.title: MT5Account · Symbol Information — Overview
docs.text:
Live quotes, symbol properties, trading rules and Market-Watch management. Discover what's tradable, read a price, and pull a symbol's contract details.

All of these live on mt5_term_api.MarketInfo. Each resolves with raw *Data (read fields with getXxx()), or rejects with MrpcError.

docs.title: Inventory & Market Watch
docs.text:
• SymbolsTotal — count of symbols (all, or only Market-Watch).
  • SymbolExist — does a symbol exist (and is it custom)?
  • SymbolName — symbol name by index.
  • SymbolSelect — add/remove a symbol from Market Watch.
  • SymbolIsSynchronized — are the symbol's rates synced with the server?

docs.title: Prices & properties
docs.text:
• SymbolInfoTick — the latest tick (bid/ask/last/volume + times) — the reliable price source.
  • SymbolInfoDouble — one SYMBOL_* double (bid, ask, point, tick value…).
  • SymbolInfoInteger — one SYMBOL_* integer (digits, spread, stops level…).
  • SymbolInfoString — one SYMBOL_* string (description, currencies, path…).

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• Need the price right now? → symbolInfoTick (bid/ask + a timestamp; the symbolInfo* property prices can be stale).
  • What can I trade? → symbolsTotal + symbolName, or symbolExist.
  • Why is my symbol silent? → it's probably not in Market Watch; symbolSelect(symbol, true) (and symbolIsSynchronized to confirm it's ready).
  • One property? → symbolInfoDouble / Integer / String with the matching property enum.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Enums Latest price (reliable) symbolInfoTick MrpcMqlTick — Count of symbols symbolsTotal SymbolsTotalData — Existence / custom flag symbolExist { exists, isCustom } — Name by index symbolName SymbolNameData — Add / remove from Market Watch symbolSelect SymbolSelectData — Rates synced? symbolIsSynchronized SymbolIsSynchronizedData — One double / integer / string prop symbolInfo{Double,Integer,String} number / string Input: SymbolInfo*Property

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Select before you read. A symbol absent from Market Watch may return a stale/empty quote — call symbolSelect(symbol, true) first, then symbolIsSynchronized.
  • Tick vs property price. symbolInfoTick is the live source; symbolInfoDouble(SYMBOL_BID/ASK) can lag.
  • Bid vs Ask. BUY orders fill at Ask, SELL orders at Bid — spread = ask − bid.
  • Digits & Point. SYMBOL_DIGITS is the decimal places (EURUSD = 5, USDJPY = 3); SYMBOL_POINT is the minimal price step (0.00001 for a 5-digit pair).
  • Volume limits. Check SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN / MAX / STEP before sending an order (or read them in bulk via symbolParamsMany).
  • Full spec in one call. For all ~30 symbol fields at once, use symbolParamsMany (group 6) instead of many symbolInfo* calls.

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Current quote (bid, ask, spread)
const tick = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
console.log(`EURUSD: Bid=${tick.getBid()}, Ask=${tick.getAsk()}, Spread=${(tick.getAsk() - tick.getBid()).toFixed(5)}`);

// List all available symbols
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const totalReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest();
totalReq.setMode(false); // false = all symbols; true = Market Watch only
const total = (await account.symbolsTotal(totalReq)).getTotal();
console.log(`Available symbols: ${total}`);

for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
  const nameReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolNameRequest();
  nameReq.setIndex(i);
  nameReq.setSelected(false);
  console.log(`${i + 1}. ${(await account.symbolName(nameReq)).getName()}`);
}

// Add a symbol to Market Watch
const ok = await account.symbolSelect('GBPUSD', true); // returns boolean
console.log(ok ? '✅ GBPUSD added to Market Watch' : '❌ Failed to add GBPUSD');

// Check whether a symbol exists
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const existReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolExistRequest();
existReq.setName('EURUSD');
const e = await account.symbolExist(existReq);
console.log(e.getExists() ? '✅ Symbol exists' : '❌ Symbol not found', '(custom:', e.getIsCustom(), ')');

// Read symbol properties — digits & point
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const dReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerRequest();
dReq.setSymbol('EURUSD');
dReq.setType(MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerProperty.SYMBOL_DIGITS);
const digits = (await account.symbolInfoInteger(dReq)).getValue();

const pReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleRequest();
pReq.setSymbol('EURUSD');
pReq.setType(MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleProperty.SYMBOL_POINT);
const point = (await account.symbolInfoDouble(pReq)).getValue();

console.log(`EURUSD: Digits=${digits}, Point=${point}`);

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Full spec: SymbolParamsMany · TickValueWithSize.
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getSymbolTick() / getSymbolParams() / getSymbolDouble().

docs.title: 🔢 Counting Symbols
docs.text:
Request: how many symbols the broker exposes, all or just those in Market Watch (SymbolsTotalData → a number), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolsTotal(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolsTotal (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolsTotal(SymbolsTotalRequest) → SymbolsTotalReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolsTotal(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the count of symbols — the whole broker list, or only the selected (Market Watch) ones.
  • Why you need it. Size a loop over SymbolName, or show how many instruments are available.
  • Sanity check. The full count is large (thousands on a typical broker).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Bound an index loop that reads each symbol's name.
  • Report "N instruments available" / "M in Market Watch".
  • Detect whether the Market Watch is empty before streaming.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Connect so the SDK has a terminal session.
  2. Choose the scope via setMode — false = all symbols, true = only selected.
  3. Call account.symbolsTotal(req) and read getTotal().
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest();
req.setMode(false);                                   // all symbols
const total = (await account.symbolsTotal(req)).getTotal();

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Count symbols. Pass a built SymbolsTotalRequest (setMode: false = all, true = selected only).
  // Called with no argument, it counts all symbols.
  symbolsTotal(req?: any /* SymbolsTotalRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolsTotalData */>;
}

Request message: SymbolsTotalRequest { bool mode = 1; } — setMode(false) = all, setMode(true) = selected only.

Reply message:

SymbolsTotalReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolsTotalData data = 1;   // getTotal(): int32
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setMode(mode) boolean false = count all symbols, true = count only Market Watch.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolsTotalData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description total getTotal() number Number of symbols in the chosen scope.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Pair it with SymbolName. Loop index from 0 to total − 1, passing the same scope.
  • The friendly count is MT5Service.getSymbolsTotal(selectedOnly), which returns the number directly.
  • All symbols can be huge — don't fetch every name unless you need to; prefer SymbolExist to check one.

docs.title: 1) Count all symbols
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest();
req.setMode(false);
console.log('all symbols:', (await account.symbolsTotal(req)).getTotal());

docs.title: 2) Count Market Watch only
docs.text:
const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest();
req.setMode(true);
console.log('in Market Watch:', (await account.symbolsTotal(req)).getTotal());

docs.title: 3) Loop over every selected symbol's name
docs.text:
const tReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest(); tReq.setMode(true);
const total = (await account.symbolsTotal(tReq)).getTotal();
for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
  const nReq = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolNameRequest(); nReq.setIndex(i); nReq.setSelected(true);
  console.log(i, (await account.symbolName(nReq)).getName());
}

docs.title: 4) Is the Market Watch empty?
docs.text:
const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest(); req.setMode(true);
if ((await account.symbolsTotal(req)).getTotal() === 0) {
  await account.symbolSelect('EURUSD', true);   // add something to watch
}

docs.title: Count both scopes
docs.text:
async function counts(account: MT5Account): Promise<{ all: number; selected: number }> {
  const a = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest(); a.setMode(false);
  const s = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolsTotalRequest(); s.setMode(true);
  const [all, selected] = await Promise.all([
    account.symbolsTotal(a).then((d) => d.getTotal()),
    account.symbolsTotal(s).then((d) => d.getTotal()),
  ]);
  return { all, selected };
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• SymbolName — the name at an index. · SymbolExist — check one symbol.
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getSymbolsTotal · MT5Sugar.getAllSymbols.

docs.title: 📂 Getting Opened Orders & Positions
docs.text:
Request: all open positions and pending orders, with full detail (OpenedOrdersData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.openedOrders(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OpenedOrders (in mt5-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: OpenedOrders(OpenedOrdersRequest) → OpenedOrdersReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.openedOrders(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning two full lists: your open positions and your pending orders.
  • Why you need it. The complete live state — tickets, volumes, prices, SL/TP, profit — for monitoring and management.
  • Sanity check. getPositionInfosList() has one entry per open position.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Render a positions / orders table.
  • Compute total floating P/L, exposure per symbol, or risk.
  • Find the ticket to modify or close.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Call account.openedOrders() (the default request returns everything).
  2. Iterate getPositionInfosList() for open positions and getOpenedOrdersList() for pending orders.
  3. Read each record's getters (ticket, symbol, volume, profit…).
const d = await account.openedOrders();
for (const p of d.getPositionInfosList()) {
  console.log(`#${p.getTicket()} ${p.getSymbol()} ${p.getVolume()} P/L ${p.getProfit()}`);
}

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Open positions + pending orders with full detail. Default request returns all.
  openedOrders(req?: any /* OpenedOrdersRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* OpenedOrdersData */>;
}

Request message: OpenedOrdersRequest {} (empty; optional sort) — built for you.

Reply message:

OpenedOrdersReply {
  oneof response {
    OpenedOrdersData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: None (the default request returns all open positions and orders).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OpenedOrdersData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Element type Description positions getPositionInfosList() PositionInfo Open positions. pending orders getOpenedOrdersList() OpenedOrderInfo Pending orders.

docs.title: PositionInfo — key getters
docs.text: Getter Description getTicket() Position ticket. getSymbol() Instrument. getType() 0 = BUY, 1 = SELL (BMT5_ENUM_POSITION_TYPE). getVolume() Lots. getPriceOpen() / getPriceCurrent() Open / current price. getStopLoss() / getTakeProfit() SL / TP. getSwap() / getProfit() / getPositionCommission() Swap / floating P/L / commission. getMagicNumber() Magic (EA id). getOpenTime() Open time (Timestamp). getIdentifier() Position identifier. getComment() Comment.

docs.title: OpenedOrderInfo — key getters
docs.text: Getter Description getTicket() Order ticket. getSymbol() Instrument. getType() Order type (TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE). getState() Order state. getVolumeInitial() / getVolumeCurrent() Initial / remaining volume. getPriceOpen() / getPriceCurrent() Trigger / current price. getStopLoss() / getTakeProfit() / getStopLimit() SL / TP / stop-limit. getMagicNumber() Magic (EA id). getTimeSetup() / getTimeExpiration() Placed / expiry time. getPositionId() Linked position id.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Two lists, two types. Positions are open trades; pending orders wait to trigger — don't conflate them.
  • Position type is 0/1. getType() === 0 is a long.
  • Timestamps are protobuf Timestamp — read .getSeconds().
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getOpenedOrders returns { positions, orders } as mapped Position[] / PendingOrder[].

docs.title: 1) List open positions
docs.text:
const d = await account.openedOrders();
for (const p of d.getPositionInfosList()) {
  console.log(`#${p.getTicket()} ${p.getSymbol()} ${p.getType() === 0 ? 'BUY' : 'SELL'} ${p.getVolume()} → ${p.getProfit()}`);
}

docs.title: 2) Total floating P/L
docs.text:
const d = await account.openedOrders();
const pnl = d.getPositionInfosList().reduce((s, p) => s + p.getProfit(), 0);
console.log('floating P/L:', pnl.toFixed(2));

docs.title: 3) Pending orders
docs.text:
const d = await account.openedOrders();
for (const o of d.getOpenedOrdersList()) {
  console.log(`#${o.getTicket()} ${o.getSymbol()} vol ${o.getVolumeCurrent()} @ ${o.getPriceOpen()}`);
}

docs.title: 4) Positions on one symbol
docs.text:
const d = await account.openedOrders();
const eur = d.getPositionInfosList().filter((p) => p.getSymbol() === 'EURUSD');
console.log('EURUSD positions:', eur.length);

docs.title: 5) Find a position by ticket
docs.text:
function findPosition(d: any, ticket: number) {
  return d.getPositionInfosList().find((p: any) => p.getTicket() === ticket);
}
const d = await account.openedOrders();
const pos = findPosition(d, 123456);
if (pos) console.log('profit', pos.getProfit());

docs.title: 6) Exposure per symbol
docs.text:
const d = await account.openedOrders();
const exposure = new Map<string, number>();
for (const p of d.getPositionInfosList()) {
  const signed = (p.getType() === 0 ? 1 : -1) * p.getVolume();
  exposure.set(p.getSymbol(), (exposure.get(p.getSymbol()) ?? 0) + signed);
}
console.log(Object.fromEntries(exposure));

docs.title: Summarise the book
docs.text:
async function summary(account: MT5Account): Promise<{ positions: number; pendings: number; pnl: number }> {
  const d = await account.openedOrders();
  const positions = d.getPositionInfosList();
  return {
    positions: positions.length,
    pendings: d.getOpenedOrdersList().length,
    pnl: positions.reduce((s: number, p: any) => s + p.getProfit(), 0),
  };
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• OpenedOrdersTickets — just the ids. · PositionsTotal
  • OrderSend / OrderClose — act on a ticket.
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getOpenedOrders / getPositions · MT5Sugar.getOpenPositions.

docs.title: 🎟️ Getting Opened Tickets
docs.text:
Request: just the ticket numbers of open positions and pending orders (OpenedOrdersTicketsData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.openedOrdersTickets(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OpenedOrdersTickets (in mt5-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: OpenedOrdersTickets(OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest) → OpenedOrdersTicketsReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.openedOrdersTickets(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning two lists of ticket numbers: open position tickets and pending order tickets.
  • Why you need it. A light "what's open" snapshot — pull full detail only when the set changes.
  • Sanity check. Both lists are empty when nothing is open.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• A cheap heartbeat to diff against a previous snapshot.
  • Drive per-ticket actions (modify, close) without fetching full records.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Call account.openedOrdersTickets() (default request).
  2. Read getOpenedPositionTicketsList() and getOpenedOrdersTicketsList() — both are number[].
const d = await account.openedOrdersTickets();
console.log('positions:', d.getOpenedPositionTicketsList());
console.log('pendings :', d.getOpenedOrdersTicketsList());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Ticket numbers of open positions and pending orders. Default request needs no arguments.
  openedOrdersTickets(req?: any /* OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* OpenedOrdersTicketsData */>;
}

Request message: OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest {} (empty) — built for you.

Reply message:

OpenedOrdersTicketsReply {
  oneof response {
    OpenedOrdersTicketsData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: None (the default request is empty).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OpenedOrdersTicketsData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description position tickets getOpenedPositionTicketsList() number[] Tickets of open positions. order tickets getOpenedOrdersTicketsList() number[] Tickets of pending orders.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Positions vs orders. Two distinct lists on MT5 — a position is an open trade, a pending order is waiting to trigger.
  • Need details? OpenedOrders returns the full records; this returns only ids.
  • Streaming equivalent: OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets pushes these lists on a timer.

docs.title: 1) List both
docs.text:
const d = await account.openedOrdersTickets();
console.log('positions:', d.getOpenedPositionTicketsList());
console.log('orders:', d.getOpenedOrdersTicketsList());

docs.title: 2) Count open positions cheaply
docs.text:
const d = await account.openedOrdersTickets();
console.log('open positions:', d.getOpenedPositionTicketsList().length);

docs.title: 3) Act on each position ticket
docs.text:
import { TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const d = await account.openedOrdersTickets();
for (const ticket of d.getOpenedPositionTicketsList()) {
  const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseRequest();
  req.setTicket(ticket);
  await account.orderClose(req);
}

docs.title: 4) Diff against a previous snapshot
docs.text:
let prev = new Set<number>();
async function changed(account: MT5Account): Promise<boolean> {
  const now = new Set((await account.openedOrdersTickets()).getOpenedPositionTicketsList());
  const diff = now.size !== prev.size || [...now].some((t) => !prev.has(t));
  prev = now;
  return diff;
}

docs.title: Snapshot helper
docs.text:
async function openTickets(account: MT5Account): Promise<{ positions: number[]; orders: number[] }> {
  const d = await account.openedOrdersTickets();
  return { positions: d.getOpenedPositionTicketsList(), orders: d.getOpenedOrdersTicketsList() };
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• OpenedOrders — the full records. · PositionsTotal
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getOpenedTickets · OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets.

docs.title: 📜 Getting Order History
docs.text:
Request: closed orders and their deals in a time window (OrdersHistoryData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.orderHistory(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderHistory (in mt5-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: OrderHistory(OrderHistoryRequest) → OrderHistoryReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.orderHistory(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the historical orders (and their deals) whose close time falls in [from, to].
  • Why you need it. Audit what was executed; reconcile orders with the deals that filled them.
  • Sanity check. getHistoryDataList() has one entry per history record.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Build a trade journal / statement.
  • Match an order to the deal(s) that executed it.
  • Feed P/L and win-rate analytics.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Pick a window — from / to as Date or epoch; the SDK converts to the protobuf Timestamp (server time).
  2. Call account.orderHistory(from, to, opts?) — opts can set sort, page, perPage.
  3. Iterate getHistoryDataList(); each HistoryData carries a getHistoryOrder() and a getHistoryDeal().
const from = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5);
const data = await account.orderHistory(from, new Date());
for (const h of data.getHistoryDataList()) {
  const o = h.getHistoryOrder();
  if (o) console.log(o.getTicket(), o.getSymbol(), o.getState());
}

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Closed orders + deals in a window. from/to are Date or epoch (server time).
  orderHistory(
    from: Date | number,
    to: Date | number,
    opts?: { sort?: number; page?: number; perPage?: number },
    timeoutMs?: number,
  ): Promise<any /* OrdersHistoryData */>;
}

Request message: OrderHistoryRequest — setInputfrom(Timestamp), setInputto(Timestamp), setInputsortmode(BMT5_ENUM_ORDER_HISTORY_SORT_TYPE), optional setPagenumber / setItemsperpage (all built from your arguments).

Reply message:

OrderHistoryReply {
  oneof response {
    OrdersHistoryData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description from / to Date \| number Window bounds (server time). opts.sort number BMT5_ENUM_ORDER_HISTORY_SORT_TYPE (default BMT5_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_DESC). opts.page / opts.perPage number Paging.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrdersHistoryData
docs.text:
Field JS accessor Description records getHistoryDataList() Array of HistoryData. total getArraytotal() Total records in the range. page getPagenumber() / getItemsperpage() Paging info. next page getNextPageToken() Continuation token.

Each HistoryData: getIndex(), getHistoryOrder() → HistoryOrderInfo, getHistoryDeal() → DealHistoryData.

HistoryOrderInfo (key getters): getTicket(), getSymbol(), getType(), getState(), getTimeSetup(), getTimeDone(), getPriceOpen(), getSl(), getTp(), getVolumeInitial(), getVolumeCurrent(), getMagic(), getPositionId(), getComment().

DealHistoryData (key getters): getTicket(), getOrder(), getSymbol(), getType(), getEntryType(), getPrice(), getVolume(), getProfit(), getCommission(), getFee(), getSwap(), getTime(), getPositionId(), getMagic().

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Window is server time. Build bounds with AccountInfo.utcServerShiftMinutes when you need exact alignment.
  • Orders vs deals. An order is the instruction; deals are the fills. One order may have several deals.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getOrderHistory returns { orders, deals } already mapped.

docs.title: 1) Last 7 days of orders
docs.text:
const from = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5);
const data = await account.orderHistory(from, new Date());
console.log('records:', data.getHistoryDataList().length);

docs.title: 2) Orders only
docs.text:
const data = await account.orderHistory(from, new Date());
for (const h of data.getHistoryDataList()) {
  const o = h.getHistoryOrder();
  if (o) console.log(o.getTicket(), o.getSymbol(), o.getVolumeInitial());
}

docs.title: 3) Deals only (realised figures)
docs.text:
const data = await account.orderHistory(from, new Date());
let realised = 0;
for (const h of data.getHistoryDataList()) {
  const d = h.getHistoryDeal();
  if (d) realised += d.getProfit() + d.getSwap() + d.getCommission() + d.getFee();
}
console.log('realised P/L:', realised.toFixed(2));

docs.title: 4) Custom sort
docs.text:
import { AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const data = await account.orderHistory(from, new Date(), {
  sort: AccountHelperPb.BMT5_ENUM_ORDER_HISTORY_SORT_TYPE.BMT5_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_ASC,
});

docs.title: 5) Paging through a large range
docs.text:
let page = 1;
for (;;) {
  const data = await account.orderHistory(from, new Date(), { page, perPage: 100 });
  const rows = data.getHistoryDataList();
  if (rows.length === 0) break;
  console.log(`page ${page}: ${rows.length} records`);
  page++;
}

docs.title: Realised P/L over a window
docs.text:
async function realisedPnl(account: MT5Account, from: Date, to: Date): Promise<number> {
  const data = await account.orderHistory(from, to);
  let pnl = 0;
  for (const h of data.getHistoryDataList()) {
    const d = h.getHistoryDeal();
    if (d) pnl += d.getProfit() + d.getSwap() + d.getCommission() + d.getFee();
  }
  return pnl;
}
