docs.title: MT5Account · Positions & Orders — Overview
docs.text:
The current order book and the history. On MT5, positions (net market exposure), orders (pending/working) and deals (executed transactions) are distinct — these methods read each.

positionsTotal lives on mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions; the rest on mt5_term_api.AccountHelper. Each resolves with raw *Data, or rejects with MrpcError.

docs.title: Current state
docs.text:
• PositionsTotal — number of open positions.
  • OpenedOrders — open positions and pending orders, with full detail.
  • OpenedOrdersTickets — just the ticket numbers (lightweight).

docs.title: History
docs.text:
• OrderHistory — historical orders and deals in a window (paged).
  • PositionsHistory — closed positions with P&L.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• How many positions are open? → positionsTotal.
  • Full blotter of positions + pending orders? → openedOrders.
  • Cheap "which tickets exist?" poll? → openedOrdersTickets.
  • What closed, and for how much? → orderHistory (orders + deals) / positionsHistory (closed positions).

🆚 Positions vs orders vs deals (MT5): a position is open exposure; a pending order rests until it triggers; a deal is an executed transaction recorded in history. Realized P/L lives on deals / closed positions.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Count of open positions positionsTotal PositionsTotalData (getTotalPositions()) Positions + pending orders (detail) openedOrders OpenedOrdersData Just the tickets openedOrdersTickets OpenedOrdersTicketsData Closed orders + deals in a window orderHistory OrdersHistoryData Closed positions with P&L positionsHistory PositionsHistoryData

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• History windows are server time. orderHistory / positionsHistory take broker-server-time bounds — build them from UTC with MT5Account.serverDate(utc, shiftMinutes) (the shift comes from accountSummary).
  • Paging. History methods accept page / items-per-page; loop pages for a long range.
  • Positions ≠ deals. A single position can span several deals (in, partial out, out). positionsHistory is per-closed-position; orderHistory exposes the raw orders & deals.

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Count open positions
const total = (await account.positionsTotal()).getTotalPositions();
console.log(`Open positions: ${total}`);

// Full blotter — positions and pending orders
const d = await account.openedOrders();
console.log(`Positions: ${d.getPositionInfosList().length}, pending: ${d.getOpenedOrdersList().length}`);

for (const pos of d.getPositionInfosList()) {
  console.log(`#${pos.getTicket()}: ${pos.getSymbol()} ${pos.getVolume()} lots @ ${pos.getPriceOpen()}, P/L: $${pos.getProfit().toFixed(2)}`);
}

// Ticket numbers only (lightweight)
const t = await account.openedOrdersTickets();
console.log('Position tickets:', t.getOpenedPositionTicketsList());
console.log('Pending-order tickets:', t.getOpenedOrdersTicketsList());

// Historical orders — last 7 days
const now = new Date();
const weekAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);

const h = await account.orderHistory(weekAgo, now, { page: 1, perPage: 100 });
for (const item of h.getHistoryDataList()) {
  const o = item.getHistoryOrder();
  if (o) console.log(`#${o.getTicket()}: ${o.getSymbol()} @ ${o.getPriceOpen()}`);
}

// Closed positions today — total realized P&L
const now = new Date();
const startOfDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

const ph = await account.positionsHistory(startOfDay, now, { page: 1, perPage: 100 });
let totalProfit = 0;
for (const pos of ph.getHistoryPositionsList()) {
  totalProfit += pos.getProfit();
  console.log(`#${pos.getPositionTicket()}: ${pos.getSymbol()} ${pos.getVolume()} lots → $${pos.getProfit().toFixed(2)}`);
}
console.log(`Total realized P&L today: $${totalProfit.toFixed(2)}`);

Dates → server time. orderHistory / positionsHistory accept a Date (or unix-ms number); the SDK converts to the broker-server-time bounds the gateway expects.

docs.title: 🗂️ Getting Positions History
docs.text:
Request: closed positions whose open time falls in a window (PositionsHistoryData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.positionsHistory(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: PositionsHistory (in mt5-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: PositionsHistory(PositionsHistoryRequest) → PositionsHistoryReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.positionsHistory(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning closed positions (net results), whose open time is in [from, to].
  • Why you need it. Per-position P/L for journals and statistics, already netted (unlike raw deals).
  • Sanity check. getHistoryPositionsList() has one entry per closed position.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Daily / weekly / monthly P/L and win-rate.
  • A clean "trades" list without reconstructing positions from deals.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Pick a window — note it filters on the position's open time.
  2. Call account.positionsHistory(from, to, opts?).
  3. Iterate getHistoryPositionsList() → PositionHistoryInfo.
const from = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 864e5);
const data = await account.positionsHistory(from, new Date());
for (const p of data.getHistoryPositionsList()) {
  console.log(p.getPositionTicket(), p.getSymbol(), p.getProfit());
}

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Closed positions whose OPEN time is in the window. from/to are Date or epoch (server time).
  positionsHistory(
    from: Date | number,
    to: Date | number,
    opts?: { sort?: number; page?: number; perPage?: number },
    timeoutMs?: number,
  ): Promise<any /* PositionsHistoryData */>;
}

Request message: PositionsHistoryRequest — setSortType(AH_ENUM_POSITIONS_HISTORY_SORT_TYPE), setPositionOpenTimeFrom(Timestamp), setPositionOpenTimeTo(Timestamp), optional setPageNumber / setItemsPerPage (built from your arguments).

Reply message:

PositionsHistoryReply {
  oneof response {
    PositionsHistoryData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description from / to Date \| number Window on the position's open time (server time). opts.sort number AH_ENUM_POSITIONS_HISTORY_SORT_TYPE (default AH_POSITION_OPEN_TIME_DESC). opts.page / opts.perPage number Paging.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — PositionsHistoryData
docs.text:
Field JS accessor Description positions getHistoryPositionsList() Array of PositionHistoryInfo. total getTotalCount() Total closed positions in the range. next page getNextPageToken() Continuation token.

PositionHistoryInfo (key getters): getPositionTicket(), getSymbol(), getOrderType(), getVolume(), getOpenPrice(), getClosePrice(), getStopLoss(), getTakeProfit(), getProfit(), getSwap(), getCommission(), getFee(), getOpenTime(), getCloseTime(), getMagic(), getComment().

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Window is on OPEN time. A position opened before from but closed inside the window is not returned — widen from if needed.
  • Net profit per position = getProfit() + getSwap() + getCommission() + getFee().
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getPositionsHistory returns mapped HistoryPosition[]; MT5Sugar.getDealsToday / getDailyStats wrap common windows.

docs.title: 1) Last 30 days
docs.text:
const from = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 864e5);
const data = await account.positionsHistory(from, new Date());
console.log('closed positions:', data.getHistoryPositionsList().length);

docs.title: 2) Net P/L over the window
docs.text:
const data = await account.positionsHistory(from, new Date());
const net = data.getHistoryPositionsList().reduce(
  (s, p) => s + p.getProfit() + p.getSwap() + p.getCommission() + p.getFee(), 0);
console.log('net P/L:', net.toFixed(2));

docs.title: 3) Win rate
docs.text:
const list = (await account.positionsHistory(from, new Date())).getHistoryPositionsList();
const wins = list.filter((p) => p.getProfit() >= 0).length;
console.log(`${wins}/${list.length} winners (${((wins / list.length) * 100).toFixed(0)}%)`);

docs.title: 4) Positions on one symbol
docs.text:
const list = (await account.positionsHistory(from, new Date())).getHistoryPositionsList();
console.log('EURUSD closed:', list.filter((p) => p.getSymbol() === 'EURUSD').length);

docs.title: 5) Oldest-first sort
docs.text:
import { AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const data = await account.positionsHistory(from, new Date(), {
  sort: AccountHelperPb.AH_ENUM_POSITIONS_HISTORY_SORT_TYPE.AH_POSITION_OPEN_TIME_ASC,
});

docs.title: Daily statistics
docs.text:
async function dailyStats(account: MT5Account, from: Date, to: Date) {
  const list = (await account.positionsHistory(from, to)).getHistoryPositionsList();
  let net = 0, wins = 0;
  for (const p of list) {
    const r = p.getProfit() + p.getSwap() + p.getCommission() + p.getFee();
    net += r;
    if (r >= 0) wins++;
  }
  return { trades: list.length, net, winRate: list.length ? (wins / list.length) * 100 : 0 };
}

docs.title: 🔢 Counting Open Positions
docs.text:
Request: how many positions are currently open (PositionsTotalData → a number), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.positionsTotal(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions
  • Proto definition: PositionsTotal (in mt5-term-api-trade-functions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions
  • Method: PositionsTotal(google.protobuf.Empty) → PositionsTotalReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradeFunctionsClient.positionsTotal(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the number of open positions (not orders, not deals).
  • Why you need it. A cheap "do I have exposure?" check before pulling full details.
  • Sanity check. 0 when flat; grows as you open positions.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• A lightweight gate: skip the heavier OpenedOrders call when the count is 0.
  • Enforce a max-positions rule before opening another.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
The request is an empty message — just call it:

const total = (await account.positionsTotal()).getTotalPositions();
console.log('open positions:', total);

The SDK sends google.protobuf.Empty for you; read getTotalPositions() from the reply.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Count open positions. No arguments (the RPC uses google.protobuf.Empty).
  positionsTotal(timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* PositionsTotalData */>;
}

Request message: google.protobuf.Empty {} (empty) — built for you.

Reply message:

PositionsTotalReply {
  oneof response {
    PositionsTotalData data = 1;   // getTotalPositions(): int32
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: None. The method takes no arguments.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — PositionsTotalData
docs.text:
Field JS accessor Type Description total positions getTotalPositions() number Count of open positions.

⚠️ The accessor is getTotalPositions() — not getTotal(). (The friendly layer wraps this; a wrong accessor silently returns 0.)

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Positions, not orders. Pending orders are counted separately — see OpenedOrders / OpenedOrdersTickets.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getPositionsTotal returns the number directly.

docs.title: 1) Basic count
docs.text:
const total = (await account.positionsTotal()).getTotalPositions();
console.log('open positions:', total);

docs.title: 2) Skip heavy work when flat
docs.text:
if ((await account.positionsTotal()).getTotalPositions() === 0) {
  console.log('nothing open');
} else {
  const d = await account.openedOrders();
  console.log('positions:', d.getPositionInfosList().length);
}

docs.title: 3) Enforce a max-positions rule
docs.text:
const MAX = 5;
if ((await account.positionsTotal()).getTotalPositions() >= MAX) {
  throw new Error('position limit reached');
}

docs.title: 4) Poll exposure
docs.text:
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  console.log('open:', (await account.positionsTotal()).getTotalPositions());
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
}

docs.title: Boolean "has exposure"
docs.text:
async function hasExposure(account: MT5Account): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await account.positionsTotal()).getTotalPositions() > 0;
}

docs.text:

docs.title: 🧮 Calculating Required Margin (OrderCalcMargin)
docs.text:
Request: the margin a prospective order would require (OrderCalcMarginData → a number), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.orderCalcMargin(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions
  • Proto definition: OrderCalcMargin (in mt5-term-api-trade-functions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions
  • Method: OrderCalcMargin(OrderCalcMarginRequest) → OrderCalcMarginReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradeFunctionsClient.orderCalcMargin(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the margin needed to open volume lots of a symbol at a price.
  • Why you need it. Size positions to your free margin before sending anything.
  • Sanity check. Returns a positive number for a valid symbol/volume.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Pre-compute margin for a prospective trade.
  • Build a "max lot I can afford" calculation.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build an OrderCalcMarginRequest — order type, symbol, volume and the open price.
  2. Call account.orderCalcMargin(req) and read getMargin().
import { MT5Account, TradeFunctionsPb, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcMarginRequest();
req.setOrderType(TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setVolume(0.10);
req.setOpenPrice(1.0950);
const margin = (await account.orderCalcMargin(req)).getMargin();

⚠️ The price setter is setOpenPrice — there is no setPrice on this request.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradeFunctionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Required margin for a prospective order. Pass a built OrderCalcMarginRequest. Returns OrderCalcMarginData.
  orderCalcMargin(req: any /* OrderCalcMarginRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* OrderCalcMarginData */>;
}

Request setters: setOrderType(TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE), setSymbol(string), setVolume(number), setOpenPrice(number).

Reply message:

OrderCalcMarginReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderCalcMarginData data = 1;   // getMargin(): double
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setOrderType(type) TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE BUY / SELL / … setSymbol(symbol) string Instrument. setVolume(volume) number Lots. setOpenPrice(price) number Price to calculate at.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderCalcMarginData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description margin getMargin() number Required margin, in the deposit currency.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Buy vs sell can differ — the margin rate may depend on the order type (see SymbolInfoMarginRate).
  • Use the current ask/bid for setOpenPrice to estimate a market order.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.calculateMargin(action, symbol, volume, price) returns the number directly; MT5Sugar.calculateRequiredMargin uses the current ask.

docs.title: 1) Margin for 0.10 lots
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradeFunctionsPb, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;

const req = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcMarginRequest();
req.setOrderType(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setVolume(0.10);
req.setOpenPrice(1.0950);
console.log('margin:', (await account.orderCalcMargin(req)).getMargin().toFixed(2));

docs.title: 2) Max affordable lots
docs.text:
const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;
const r = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcMarginRequest();
r.setOrderType(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY); r.setSymbol('EURUSD'); r.setVolume(1.0); r.setOpenPrice(1.0950);
const perLot = (await account.orderCalcMargin(r)).getMargin();
// freeMargin / perLot → max lots (then clamp to volume step)

docs.title: 3) A reusable helper
docs.text:
function calcMargin(account: MT5Account, type: number, symbol: string, volume: number, price: number): Promise<number> {
  const r = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcMarginRequest();
  r.setOrderType(type); r.setSymbol(symbol); r.setVolume(volume); r.setOpenPrice(price);
  return account.orderCalcMargin(r).then((d) => d.getMargin());
}

docs.title: Fundability gate
docs.text:
async function canAfford(account: MT5Account, symbol: string, volume: number, ask: number, freeMargin: number): Promise<boolean> {
  const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;
  const r = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcMarginRequest();
  r.setOrderType(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY); r.setSymbol(symbol); r.setVolume(volume); r.setOpenPrice(ask);
  return (await account.orderCalcMargin(r)).getMargin() <= freeMargin;
}

docs.title: 💰 Calculating Profit (OrderCalcProfit)
docs.text:
Request: the profit of a prospective trade between two prices (OrderCalcProfitData → a number), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.orderCalcProfit(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions
  • Proto definition: OrderCalcProfit (in mt5-term-api-trade-functions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions
  • Method: OrderCalcProfit(OrderCalcProfitRequest) → OrderCalcProfitReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradeFunctionsClient.orderCalcProfit(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the profit of moving volume lots of a symbol from openPrice to closePrice in the given direction.
  • Why you need it. Preview the money value of a target or a stop — "what would 40 pips be worth?"
  • Sanity check. A BUY from a lower to a higher price returns a positive number.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Convert a price target into account-currency profit.
  • Size a take-profit by the money you want to make.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build an OrderCalcProfitRequest — order type, symbol, volume, open and close prices.
  2. Call account.orderCalcProfit(req) and read getProfit().
import { MT5Account, TradeFunctionsPb, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcProfitRequest();
req.setOrderType(TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setVolume(0.10);
req.setOpenPrice(1.0950);
req.setClosePrice(1.1000);
const profit = (await account.orderCalcProfit(req)).getProfit();

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradeFunctionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Profit of a prospective trade. Pass a built OrderCalcProfitRequest. Returns OrderCalcProfitData.
  orderCalcProfit(req: any /* OrderCalcProfitRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* OrderCalcProfitData */>;
}

Request setters: setOrderType(TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE), setSymbol(string), setVolume(number), setOpenPrice(number), setClosePrice(number).

Reply message:

OrderCalcProfitReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderCalcProfitData data = 1;   // getProfit(): double
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setOrderType(type) TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE BUY / SELL / … setSymbol(symbol) string Instrument. setVolume(volume) number Lots. setOpenPrice(price) number Entry price. setClosePrice(price) number Exit price.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderCalcProfitData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description profit getProfit() number Profit (negative = loss), in the deposit currency.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Direction matters. For a SELL, a profit occurs when closePrice < openPrice.
  • Excludes costs. This is gross price P/L — commissions and swap are separate.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.calculateProfit(action, symbol, volume, openPrice, closePrice) returns the number directly.

docs.title: 1) Profit of a 50-pip BUY move

const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;

const req = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcProfitRequest();

req.setOpenPrice(1.0950);
req.setClosePrice(1.1000);

r.setOrderType(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY); r.setSymbol('EURUSD'); r.setVolume(0.10);

docs.title: 3) A reusable helper
docs.text:
function calcProfit(account: MT5Account, type: number, symbol: string, volume: number, open: number, close: number): Promise<number> {
  const r = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcProfitRequest();
  r.setOrderType(type); r.setSymbol(symbol); r.setVolume(volume); r.setOpenPrice(open); r.setClosePrice(close);
  return account.orderCalcProfit(r).then((d) => d.getProfit());
}

docs.title: Risk-reward of a planned trade
docs.text:
async function riskReward(account: MT5Account, symbol: string, volume: number, entry: number, sl: number, tp: number) {
  const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;
  const risk = Math.abs(await calcProfit(account, OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY, symbol, volume, entry, sl));
  const reward = Math.abs(await calcProfit(account, OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY, symbol, volume, entry, tp));
  return { risk, reward, ratio: reward / risk };
}

docs.title: ✅ Validating an Order (OrderCheck)
docs.text:
Request: validate a prospective order before sending it — margin, balance / equity / free margin after the deal (OrderCheckData), on MT5.

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions
  • Method: OrderCheck(OrderCheckRequest) → OrderCheckReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradeFunctionsClient.orderCheck(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that pre-flights an order — the broker checks it without sending.
  • Why you need it. Confirm an order is fundable and legal (margin, stops) before OrderSend.
  • Sanity check. getMqlTradeCheckResult().getReturnedCode() is 0 when the order would be accepted.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Pre-validate size and stops to avoid 10019 / 10016 on the real send.
  • Preview balance / equity / free margin after the hypothetical deal.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build an MrpcMqlTradeRequest describing the order (symbol, volume, action…).
  2. Wrap it in an OrderCheckRequest via setMqlTradeRequest.
  3. Call account.orderCheck(req) and read getMqlTradeCheckResult().
import { MT5Account, TradeFunctionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const mql = new TradeFunctionsPb.MrpcMqlTradeRequest();
mql.setSymbol('EURUSD');
mql.setVolume(0.10);
// set action / order type / price as needed …

const req = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCheckRequest();
req.setMqlTradeRequest(mql);

const r = (await account.orderCheck(req)).getMqlTradeCheckResult();
console.log('ok?', r.getReturnedCode() === 0, 'margin', r.getMargin());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradeFunctionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Validate an order. Pass a built OrderCheckRequest (wraps an MqlTradeRequest). Returns OrderCheckData.
  orderCheck(req: any /* OrderCheckRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* OrderCheckData */>;
}

Request: OrderCheckRequest.setMqlTradeRequest(MrpcMqlTradeRequest). The MrpcMqlTradeRequest carries setAction, setOrderType, setSymbol, setVolume, setPrice, setStopLoss, setTakeProfit, setDeviation, setExpertAdvisorMagicNumber, … (the full trade request).

Reply message:

OrderCheckReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderCheckData data = 1;   // getMqlTradeCheckResult()
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setMqlTradeRequest(req) MrpcMqlTradeRequest The prospective order to validate.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderCheckData → getMqlTradeCheckResult()
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description returned code getReturnedCode() number 0 = would be accepted. balance after getBalanceAfterDeal() number Balance after the deal. equity after getEquityAfterDeal() number Equity after the deal. profit getProfit() number Expected profit. margin getMargin() number Margin the order would use. free margin getFreeMargin() number Free margin after the deal. margin level getMarginLevel() number Margin level after the deal. comment getComment() string Broker comment.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• 0 is good here. Unlike OrderSend (where 10009 = done), the check's getReturnedCode() is 0 when the order would be accepted.
  • Check doesn't trade. It only simulates — follow with OrderSend to actually place it.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.checkOrder returns a mapped OrderCheckResult.

docs.title: 1) Basic pre-flight
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradeFunctionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const mql = new TradeFunctionsPb.MrpcMqlTradeRequest();
mql.setSymbol('EURUSD');
mql.setVolume(0.10);

const req = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCheckRequest();
req.setMqlTradeRequest(mql);

const r = (await account.orderCheck(req)).getMqlTradeCheckResult();
console.log('accepted?', r.getReturnedCode() === 0);

docs.title: 2) Preview free margin after the deal
docs.text:
const r = (await account.orderCheck(req)).getMqlTradeCheckResult();
console.log('free margin after:', r.getFreeMargin().toFixed(2));

docs.title: 3) Gate a real send on the check
docs.text:
const r = (await account.orderCheck(req)).getMqlTradeCheckResult();
if (r.getReturnedCode() === 0) {
  // build & send the matching OrderSendRequest …
} else {
  console.warn('check failed:', r.getComment());
}

docs.title: Fundable check
docs.text:
async function isFundable(account: MT5Account, checkReq: any): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = (await account.orderCheck(checkReq)).getMqlTradeCheckResult();
  return r.getReturnedCode() === 0 && r.getFreeMargin() >= 0;
}

  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.checkOrder → OrderCheckResult.

docs.title: ❌ Closing a Position / Deleting a Pending
docs.text:
Request: close a position (fully or partially) or delete a pending order (OrderCloseData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.orderClose(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderClose (in mt5-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderClose(OrderCloseRequest) → OrderCloseReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelperClient.orderClose(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 🛑 Result is in the retcode
docs.text: orderClose rejects only on a transport error. A broker rejection is in the result — check getReturnedCode(): 10009 = DONE.

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that closes a position (set volume for a partial close) or deletes a pending order, by ticket.
  • Why you need it. Exit a trade, scale out, or cancel a pending order.
  • Sanity check. getReturnedCode() === 10009.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Close a position fully, or scale out part of it.
  • Delete a pending order you no longer want.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build an OrderCloseRequest with the ticket (and volume for a partial close).
  2. Call account.orderClose(req).
  3. Check getReturnedCode() (10009 = done).
import { MT5Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseRequest();
req.setTicket(ticket);
const d = await account.orderClose(req);
console.log(d.getReturnedCode() === 10009 ? 'closed' : d.getReturnedCodeDescription());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Close a position (full/partial) or delete a pending order. Pass a built OrderCloseRequest.
  orderClose(req: any /* OrderCloseRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* OrderCloseData */>;
}

Request setters: setTicket(number), setVolume(number) (omit / 0 = full close), setSlippage(number).

Reply message:

OrderCloseReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderCloseData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setTicket(ticket) number Position or pending-order ticket. setVolume(volume) number Lots to close; omit or 0 = full close. setSlippage(points) number Max deviation.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderCloseData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description returned code getReturnedCode() number Trade retcode — 10009 = DONE. returned code desc getReturnedCodeDescription() string Human-readable result. returned string code getReturnedStringCode() string Symbolic code. close mode getCloseMode() number How it was closed.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Partial close keeps the rest open. Pass a volume below the position size; the remainder stays with the same ticket.
  • Deleting a pending uses the same call — pass the pending order's ticket.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.closeOrder(CloseRequest); MT5Sugar.closePosition / closePositionPartial / closeAllPositions.

docs.title: 1) Full close
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseRequest();
req.setTicket(ticket);
const d = await account.orderClose(req);
console.log(d.getReturnedCode() === 10009 ? 'closed' : d.getReturnedCodeDescription());

docs.title: 2) Partial close (0.05 lots)
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseRequest();
req.setTicket(ticket);
req.setVolume(0.05);
await account.orderClose(req);

docs.title: 3) Delete a pending order
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseRequest();
req.setTicket(pendingTicket);
await account.orderClose(req);

docs.title: 4) Close every open position
docs.text:
const open = await account.openedOrders();
for (const p of open.getPositionInfosList()) {
  const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseRequest();
  req.setTicket(p.getTicket());
  const d = await account.orderClose(req);
  if (d.getReturnedCode() !== 10009) console.warn('skip', p.getTicket(), d.getReturnedCodeDescription());
}

docs.title: 5) React to the retcode
docs.text:
const d = await account.orderClose(req);
if (d.getReturnedCode() === 10009) console.log('done');
else if (d.getReturnedCode() === 10036) console.log('already closed');
else console.log('rejected:', d.getReturnedCodeDescription());

docs.title: Close helper that throws on failure
docs.text:
async function close(account: MT5Account, ticket: number, volume?: number): Promise<void> {
  const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseRequest();
  req.setTicket(ticket);
  if (volume) req.setVolume(volume);
  const d = await account.orderClose(req);
  if (d.getReturnedCode() !== 10009) throw new Error(`close ${ticket} rejected: ${d.getReturnedCodeDescription()}`);
}

docs.text:

  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.closeOrder · MT5Sugar.closePosition / closeAllPositions.

docs.title: ✏️ Modifying an Order
docs.text:
Request: change SL/TP of a position, or SL/TP/price/expiration of a pending order (OrderModifyData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.orderModify(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderModify (in mt5-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderModify(OrderModifyRequest) → OrderModifyReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelperClient.orderModify(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 🛑 Result is in the retcode
docs.text: Like OrderSend, orderModify rejects only on a transport error. A broker rejection comes back in the result — check getReturnedCode(): 10009 = DONE.

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that updates an existing order/position by ticket.
  • Why you need it. Move a stop (trailing), set a take-profit, re-price a pending order.
  • Sanity check. getReturnedCode() === 10009.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Trail or tighten a stop-loss as price moves.
  • Add or change a take-profit after entry.
  • Re-price or re-time a pending order.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build an OrderModifyRequest with the ticket and the fields to change.
  2. Call account.orderModify(req).
  3. Check getReturnedCode() (10009 = done).
import { MT5Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
req.setTicket(ticket);
req.setStopLoss(1.0900);
req.setTakeProfit(1.1100);
const d = await account.orderModify(req);
console.log(d.getReturnedCode() === 10009 ? 'modified' : d.getReturnedCodeDescription());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Modify SL/TP/price/expiration. Pass a built OrderModifyRequest. Returns OrderModifyData.
  orderModify(req: any /* OrderModifyRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* OrderModifyData */>;
}

Request setters: setTicket(number), setStopLoss(number), setTakeProfit(number), setPrice(number) (pending only), setStopLimit(number), setExpirationTimeType(number), setExpirationTime(Timestamp).

Reply message:

OrderModifyReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderModifyData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setTicket(ticket) number Position / order ticket. setStopLoss / setTakeProfit number New SL / TP prices (0 leaves unset where supported). setPrice number New trigger price (pending orders). setStopLimit number New stop-limit price. setExpirationTimeType / setExpirationTime number / Timestamp New expiry (pending).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderModifyData
docs.text: Same shape as OrderSend → Output: getReturnedCode() (10009 = DONE), getReturnedCodeDescription(), getReturnedStringCode(), getOrder(), getDeal(), getPrice(), …

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Stops level applies. A new SL/TP closer than SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL → 10016.
  • No-op is a rejection. Re-sending identical values can return 10025 NO_CHANGES.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.modifyOrder(ModifyRequest); MT5Sugar.modifyPositionSL / TP / SLTP.

docs.title: 1) Set SL and TP
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
req.setTicket(ticket);
req.setStopLoss(1.0900);
req.setTakeProfit(1.1100);
await account.orderModify(req);

docs.title: 2) Move the stop only (trailing step)
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
req.setTicket(ticket);
req.setStopLoss(newStop);
const d = await account.orderModify(req);
if (d.getReturnedCode() === 10009) console.log('stop moved to', newStop);

docs.title: 3) Re-price a pending order
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
req.setTicket(pendingTicket);
req.setPrice(1.0920);
await account.orderModify(req);

docs.title: 4) React to the retcode
docs.text:
const d = await account.orderModify(req);
switch (d.getReturnedCode()) {
  case 10009: console.log('modified'); break;
  case 10025: console.log('no changes'); break;
  case 10016: console.log('invalid stops'); break;
  default:    console.log('rejected:', d.getReturnedCodeDescription());
}

docs.title: Trailing-stop step
docs.text:
async function trailStop(account: MT5Account, ticket: number, newStop: number, bestStop: number): Promise<number> {
  if (newStop <= bestStop) return bestStop;             // only move up
  const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
  req.setTicket(ticket); req.setStopLoss(newStop);
  const d = await account.orderModify(req);
  return d.getReturnedCode() === 10009 ? newStop : bestStop;
}

docs.text:
• OrderSend · OrderClose
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.modifyOrder · MT5Sugar.modifyPositionSLTP.

docs.title: 🛒 Sending an Order (Market or Pending)
docs.text:
Request: place a market or pending order (OrderSendData) on MT5. A filled market order's ticket is its position ticket.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.orderSend(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderSend (in mt5-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderSend(OrderSendRequest) → OrderSendReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelperClient.orderSend(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 🛑 Result is in the retcode
docs.text: orderSend rejects the promise only on an API/transport error. A broker rejection is in the result — check getReturnedCode(): 10009 = DONE. There is no exception for an ordinary rejection.

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that opens a market order or places a pending order.
  • Why you need it. It's how you enter the market — everything else acts on the ticket it returns.
  • Sanity check. getReturnedCode() === 10009 and getOrder() is non-zero.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Open a position at market, or arm a pending order (LIMIT / STOP / STOP_LIMIT).
  • Attach SL/TP and a magic number at entry.
  • Get back the ticket to manage the trade.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Select the symbol (SymbolSelect).
  2. Build an OrderSendRequest — at minimum symbol, operation and volume.
  3. Call account.orderSend(req) and check getReturnedCode() (10009 = done).
import { MT5Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperation(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
req.setVolume(0.10);

const d = await account.orderSend(req);
if (d.getReturnedCode() === 10009) console.log('opened #', d.getOrder());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Place a market/pending order. Pass a built OrderSendRequest. Returns raw OrderSendData.
  orderSend(req: any /* OrderSendRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* OrderSendData */>;
}

Request message (OrderSendRequest) — key setters:

Setter Meaning setSymbol(string) Instrument. setOperation(TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE) BUY / SELL / *_LIMIT / *_STOP / *_STOP_LIMIT. setVolume(number) Lots. setPrice(number) Required for pending; reference price for market. setStopLoss(number) / setTakeProfit(number) SL / TP prices. setSlippage(number) Max deviation (points). setExpertId(number) Magic number. setStopLimitPrice(number) For *_STOP_LIMIT. setExpirationTimeType(number) / setExpirationTime(Timestamp) Pending expiry. setQuotesWaitMs(number) How long to wait for the first quote (ms).

Reply message:

OrderSendReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderSendData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🧱 Order type enum — TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE
docs.text:
TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY = 0   SELL = 1   BUY_LIMIT = 2   SELL_LIMIT = 3
BUY_STOP = 4   SELL_STOP = 5   BUY_STOP_LIMIT = 6   SELL_STOP_LIMIT = 7   CLOSE_BY = 8

Access as TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderSendData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description returned code getReturnedCode() number Trade retcode — 10009 = DONE. returned code desc getReturnedCodeDescription() string Human-readable result. returned string code getReturnedStringCode() string Symbolic code (e.g. TRADE_RETCODE_DONE). order getOrder() number Order / position ticket. deal getDeal() number Deal id (market fills). volume getVolume() number Filled volume. price getPrice() number Fill / set price. bid / ask getBid() / getAsk() number Prices at execution. comment getComment() string Broker comment. request id getRequestId() number Request id. external code getRetCodeExternal() number External system code.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Always check getReturnedCode(). 10019 = no money, 10016 = invalid stops, 10018 = market closed — see Return Codes.
  • Stops level. SL/TP closer than SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL → 10016. See SymbolInfoInteger.
  • Pending needs a price. Market orders fill at the current price; pending orders require setPrice.
  • Deal vs order ticket. For a filled market order getOrder() equals the position ticket; getDeal() is the deal id.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.placeOrder(OrderRequest) builds all of this from plain fields and maps the result to OrderResult.

docs.title: 1) Market BUY
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperation(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
req.setVolume(0.10);

const d = await account.orderSend(req);
if (d.getReturnedCode() === 10009) console.log('opened #' + d.getOrder(), '@', d.getPrice());
else console.log('rejected:', d.getReturnedCode(), d.getReturnedCodeDescription());

docs.title: 2) Pending BUY LIMIT with SL/TP
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperation(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT);
req.setVolume(0.10);
req.setPrice(1.0900);           // required for pending
req.setStopLoss(1.0850);
req.setTakeProfit(1.1000);
const d = await account.orderSend(req);

docs.title: 3) Market SELL with a magic number
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperation(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_SELL);
req.setVolume(0.10);
req.setExpertId(600042);
await account.orderSend(req);

docs.title: 4) React to the retcode
docs.text:
const d = await account.orderSend(req);
switch (d.getReturnedCode()) {
  case 10009: console.log('done, ticket', d.getOrder()); break;
  case 10019: console.log('not enough money'); break;
  case 10016: console.log('invalid stops'); break;
  case 10018: console.log('market closed'); break;
  default:    console.log('rejected:', d.getReturnedCodeDescription());
}

docs.title: 5) BUY STOP LIMIT
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperation(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY_STOP_LIMIT);
req.setVolume(0.10);
req.setPrice(1.1050);           // stop trigger
req.setStopLimitPrice(1.1045);  // limit once triggered
await account.orderSend(req);

docs.title: 6) A tiny open helper
docs.text:
async function buy(account: MT5Account, symbol: string, volume: number): Promise<number> {
  const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;
  const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
  req.setSymbol(symbol); req.setOperation(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY); req.setVolume(volume);
  const d = await account.orderSend(req);
  if (d.getReturnedCode() !== 10009) throw new Error(`rejected ${d.getReturnedCode()}: ${d.getReturnedCodeDescription()}`);
  return d.getOrder();
}

docs.title: Open with retry on requote
docs.text:
async function openWithRetry(account: MT5Account, req: any, tries = 3): Promise<any> {
  for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {
    const d = await account.orderSend(req);
    const code = d.getReturnedCode();
    if (code === 10009) return d;                 // done
    if (code !== 10004 && code !== 10020) return d; // non-requote → stop
  }
  throw new Error('requoted too many times');
}

docs.text:
• OrderModify · OrderClose · OrderCheck — validate before sending.
  • Return Codes Reference.
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.placeOrder → OrderResult · MT5Sugar.buyMarket / sellMarket / buyLimit.

docs.title: MT5Account · Trading Operations — Overview
docs.text: Place, modify and close orders, and validate / size a trade before sending it. orderSend / orderModify / orderClose live on mt5_term_api.TradingHelper; orderCheck / orderCalcMargin / orderCalcProfit on mt5_term_api.TradeFunctions.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• OrderSend — send a market or pending order.
  • OrderModify — change SL/TP (and price/expiration for pendings).
  • OrderClose — close a position (full/partial) or delete a pending order.
  • OrderCheck — validate an order before sending (margin, free margin after deal…).
  • OrderCalcMargin — required margin for a prospective order.
  • OrderCalcProfit — profit of a prospective trade.

docs.title: 🛑 Trade result: the retcode
docs.text:
MT5 trades carry a trade-server return code. 10009 = DONE (success). orderSend / orderModify / orderClose reject only on an API/transport error; a broker rejection comes back in the result with a non-10009 getReturnedCode(). Always check it.

const d = await account.orderSend(req);
if (d.getReturnedCode() === 10009) console.log('filled, ticket', d.getOrder());
else console.log('rejected:', d.getReturnedCode(), d.getReturnedCodeDescription());

Common codes: 10009 DONE · 10004 REQUOTE · 10006 REJECTED · 10013 INVALID · 10014 INVALID_VOLUME · 10015 INVALID_PRICE · 10016 INVALID_STOPS · 10019 NO_MONEY · 10018 MARKET_CLOSED. See Return Codes.

docs.title: 🧱 Order type enum — TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE
docs.text:
TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY = 0   SELL = 1   BUY_LIMIT = 2   SELL_LIMIT = 3
BUY_STOP = 4   SELL_STOP = 5   BUY_STOP_LIMIT = 6   SELL_STOP_LIMIT = 7   CLOSE_BY = 8

Access as TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY.

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Validate first. MT5 does have pre-trade calculators — use orderCheck / orderCalcMargin before sending.
  • Stops level. SL/TP closer than SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL → retcode 10016. See SymbolInfoInteger.
  • Market must be open — 10018 out of session.
  • Deal vs order ticket. A filled market order's getOrder() equals the resulting position ticket; getDeal() is the deal id.

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Place a BUY market order with SL/TP
import { TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperation(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
req.setVolume(0.10);
req.setStopLoss(1.08000);
req.setTakeProfit(1.09000);

const d = await account.orderSend(req);
if (d.getReturnedCode() === 10009) console.log(`✅ Order placed: #${d.getOrder()}`);
else console.log(`❌ Rejected: ${d.getReturnedCodeDescription()} (code ${d.getReturnedCode()})`);

// Validate before sending (OrderCheck wraps a MrpcMqlTradeRequest; 0 = would be accepted)
import { TradeFunctionsPb, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const tick = await account.symbolInfoTick('EURUSD');
const mql = new TradeFunctionsPb.MrpcMqlTradeRequest();
mql.setSymbol('EURUSD');
mql.setOrderType(TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
mql.setVolume(0.10);
mql.setPrice(tick.getAsk());

const checkReq = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCheckRequest();
checkReq.setMqlTradeRequest(mql);
const r = (await account.orderCheck(checkReq)).getMqlTradeCheckResult();
console.log(r.getReturnedCode() === 0 ? '✅ Validation passed' : `❌ ${r.getComment()}`);

// Calculate required margin, then compare with free margin
import { TradeFunctionsPb, TradingHelperPb, AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const mReq = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcMarginRequest();
mReq.setOrderType(TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
mReq.setSymbol('EURUSD');
mReq.setVolume(1.0);
mReq.setOpenPrice(1.08500);
const margin = (await account.orderCalcMargin(mReq)).getMargin();

const free = await account.accountInfoDouble(AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType.ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);
console.log(margin <= free ? `✅ Sufficient margin ($${margin.toFixed(2)})` : `❌ Need $${margin.toFixed(2)}, have $${free.toFixed(2)}`);

// Modify SL/TP of an open position
import { TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
req.setTicket(ticket);
req.setStopLoss(1.08200);
req.setTakeProfit(1.09500);
const d = await account.orderModify(req);
console.log(d.getReturnedCode() === 10009 ? '✅ SL/TP modified' : `❌ ${d.getReturnedCodeDescription()}`);

// Close a position (omit / 0 volume = full close)
import { TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseRequest();
req.setTicket(ticket);
req.setSlippage(20);
const d = await account.orderClose(req);
console.log(d.getReturnedCode() === 10009 ? `✅ Closed (mode ${d.getCloseMode()})` : `❌ ${d.getReturnedCodeDescription()}`);

// Estimate profit for a prospective move (+50 pips)
import { TradeFunctionsPb, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcProfitRequest();
req.setOrderType(TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setVolume(0.10);
req.setOpenPrice(1.08500);
req.setClosePrice(1.09000);
console.log(`Potential profit: $${(await account.orderCalcProfit(req)).getProfit().toFixed(2)}`);

docs.title: 🧩 Full pre-trade workflow (size → check → send)
docs.text:
import { TradeFunctionsPb, TradingHelperPb, AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;
const symbol = 'EURUSD', volume = 0.10, sl = 1.08000, tp = 1.09000;

const tick = await account.symbolInfoTick(symbol);

// 1) margin vs free margin
const mReq = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCalcMarginRequest();
mReq.setOrderType(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY); mReq.setSymbol(symbol); mReq.setVolume(volume); mReq.setOpenPrice(tick.getAsk());
const margin = (await account.orderCalcMargin(mReq)).getMargin();
const free = await account.accountInfoDouble(AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType.ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);
if (margin > free) throw new Error('Insufficient margin');

// 2) validate
const mql = new TradeFunctionsPb.MrpcMqlTradeRequest();
mql.setSymbol(symbol); mql.setOrderType(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY); mql.setVolume(volume); mql.setPrice(tick.getAsk()); mql.setStopLoss(sl); mql.setTakeProfit(tp);
const checkReq = new TradeFunctionsPb.OrderCheckRequest(); checkReq.setMqlTradeRequest(mql);
const chk = (await account.orderCheck(checkReq)).getMqlTradeCheckResult();
if (chk.getReturnedCode() !== 0) throw new Error(`Validation failed: ${chk.getComment()}`);

// 3) send
const sReq = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
sReq.setSymbol(symbol); sReq.setOperation(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY); sReq.setVolume(volume); sReq.setStopLoss(sl); sReq.setTakeProfit(tp);
const res = await account.orderSend(sReq);
if (res.getReturnedCode() === 10009) console.log(`✅ Order placed: #${res.getOrder()}`);
else throw new Error(`Order failed: ${res.getReturnedCodeDescription()}`);

  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.placeOrder / modifyOrder / closeOrder / checkOrder / calculateMargin / calculateProfit; one-liners in MT5Sugar.

docs.title: 📖 Subscribing to Market Depth (MarketBookAdd)
docs.text:
Request: subscribe to the order book (Depth of Market) of a symbol (MarketBookAddData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.marketBookAdd(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: MarketBookAdd (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: MarketBookAdd(MarketBookAddRequest) → MarketBookAddReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.marketBookAdd(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that opens a Depth-of-Market subscription for a symbol so MarketBookGet can return levels.
  • Why you need it. You must subscribe before reading the book.
  • Sanity check. getOpenedSuccessfully() is true.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Begin watching the order book of a symbol that provides DOM.
  • First step of the subscribe → read → release lifecycle.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build a MarketBookAddRequest with the symbol.
  2. Call account.marketBookAdd(req) and check getOpenedSuccessfully().
  3. Then poll MarketBookGet; MarketBookRelease when done.
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookAddRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const ok = (await account.marketBookAdd(req)).getOpenedSuccessfully();

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Subscribe to DOM for a symbol. Pass a built MarketBookAddRequest (setSymbol).
  marketBookAdd(req: any /* MarketBookAddRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* MarketBookAddData */>;
}

Request message: MarketBookAddRequest { string symbol = 1; } — setSymbol(string).

Reply message:

MarketBookAddReply {
  oneof response {
    MarketBookAddData data = 1;   // getOpenedSuccessfully(): bool
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(symbol) string Instrument to subscribe to.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — MarketBookAddData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description opened getOpenedSuccessfully() boolean true if the subscription opened.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Not every symbol has DOM. Even on a successful subscribe, MarketBookGet may return an empty book.
  • Always release. Pair every marketBookAdd with a MarketBookRelease to free the subscription.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.subscribeMarketDepth(symbol) returns the boolean directly.

docs.title: 1) Subscribe
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookAddRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
console.log('subscribed?', (await account.marketBookAdd(req)).getOpenedSuccessfully());

docs.title: 2) Subscribe, read, release
docs.text:
const add = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookAddRequest(); add.setSymbol('EURUSD');
await account.marketBookAdd(add);

const get = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookGetRequest(); get.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const book = (await account.marketBookGet(get)).getMqlBookInfosList();
console.log('levels:', book.length);

const rel = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookReleaseRequest(); rel.setSymbol('EURUSD');
await account.marketBookRelease(rel);

docs.title: 3) Guard on the result
docs.text:
const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookAddRequest(); req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
if (!(await account.marketBookAdd(req)).getOpenedSuccessfully()) {
  console.warn('DOM not available for EURUSD');
}

docs.title: Subscribe helper
docs.text:
async function subscribeDepth(account: MT5Account, symbol: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookAddRequest();
  req.setSymbol(symbol);
  return (await account.marketBookAdd(req)).getOpenedSuccessfully();
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• MarketBookGet — read the levels. · MarketBookRelease — unsubscribe.
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.subscribeMarketDepth.

docs.title: 📖 Reading the Order Book (MarketBookGet)
docs.text:
Request: the current Depth-of-Market levels of a subscribed symbol (MarketBookGetData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.marketBookGet(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: MarketBookGet (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: MarketBookGet(MarketBookGetRequest) → MarketBookGetReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.marketBookGet(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the order-book levels (price + volume per level) for a symbol you've subscribed to.
  • Why you need it. See resting buy/sell liquidity around the market.
  • Sanity check. After MarketBookAdd, getMqlBookInfosList() has entries (when the broker provides DOM).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Inspect bid/ask depth and sizes.
  • Build a DOM ladder display or liquidity metric.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Subscribe first with MarketBookAdd.
  2. Build a MarketBookGetRequest with the symbol.
  3. Call account.marketBookGet(req) and iterate getMqlBookInfosList().
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookGetRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
for (const lvl of (await account.marketBookGet(req)).getMqlBookInfosList()) {
  console.log(lvl.getType(), lvl.getPrice(), lvl.getVolume());
}

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Read the order book. Pass a built MarketBookGetRequest (setSymbol).
  marketBookGet(req: any /* MarketBookGetRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* MarketBookGetData */>;
}

Request message: MarketBookGetRequest { string symbol = 1; } — setSymbol(string).

Reply message:

MarketBookGetReply {
  oneof response {
    MarketBookGetData data = 1;   // getMqlBookInfosList(): MrpcMqlBookInfo[]
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(symbol) string Subscribed instrument.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — MarketBookGetData
docs.text:
getMqlBookInfosList() → array of MrpcMqlBookInfo:

Getter Type Description getType() number Level type — MQL5 ENUM_BOOK_TYPE (sell / buy / sell-market / buy-market). getPrice() number Price of the level. getVolume() number Volume (integer). getVolumeReal() number Real volume.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Subscribe first. Without MarketBookAdd the list is empty.
  • Empty is valid. A symbol without DOM returns [] even after a successful subscribe.
  • Poll, don't spin. Add a delay between reads; there's no push here (use the streaming methods for events).
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getMarketDepth(symbol) returns mapped BookInfo[].

docs.title: 1) List all levels
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookGetRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const book = (await account.marketBookGet(req)).getMqlBookInfosList();
book.forEach((l) => console.log(l.getType(), l.getPrice(), l.getVolume()));

docs.title: 2) Total bid vs ask volume
docs.text:
const book = (await account.marketBookGet(req)).getMqlBookInfosList();
let buyVol = 0, sellVol = 0;
for (const l of book) {
  // even/odd type codes split buy vs sell depending on the broker's ENUM_BOOK_TYPE
  (l.getType() % 2 === 0 ? (sellVol += l.getVolume()) : (buyVol += l.getVolume()));
}
console.log({ buyVol, sellVol });

docs.title: 3) Best bid / ask from the book
docs.text:
const book = (await account.marketBookGet(req)).getMqlBookInfosList();
const prices = book.map((l) => l.getPrice()).filter((p) => p > 0);
console.log('tightest levels:', Math.min(...prices), Math.max(...prices));

docs.title: Read with auto subscribe/release
docs.text:
async function readBook(account: MT5Account, symbol: string): Promise<any[]> {
  const add = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookAddRequest(); add.setSymbol(symbol);
  await account.marketBookAdd(add);
  try {
    const get = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookGetRequest(); get.setSymbol(symbol);
    return (await account.marketBookGet(get)).getMqlBookInfosList();
  } finally {
    const rel = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookReleaseRequest(); rel.setSymbol(symbol);
    await account.marketBookRelease(rel);
  }
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• MarketBookAdd — subscribe first. · MarketBookRelease
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getMarketDepth → BookInfo[].

docs.title: 📕 Unsubscribing from Market Depth (MarketBookRelease)
docs.text:
Request: close a Depth-of-Market subscription for a symbol (MarketBookReleaseData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.marketBookRelease(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: MarketBookRelease (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: MarketBookRelease(MarketBookReleaseRequest) → MarketBookReleaseReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.marketBookRelease(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that ends a DOM subscription opened by MarketBookAdd.
  • Why you need it. Free the subscription when you're done watching the book.
  • Sanity check. getClosedSuccessfully() is true.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• The final step of the subscribe → read → release lifecycle.
  • Avoid leaking server-side DOM subscriptions.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build a MarketBookReleaseRequest with the symbol.
  2. Call account.marketBookRelease(req) and check getClosedSuccessfully().
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookReleaseRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const ok = (await account.marketBookRelease(req)).getClosedSuccessfully();

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Unsubscribe from DOM for a symbol. Pass a built MarketBookReleaseRequest (setSymbol).
  marketBookRelease(req: any /* MarketBookReleaseRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* MarketBookReleaseData */>;
}

Request message: MarketBookReleaseRequest { string symbol = 1; } — setSymbol(string).

Reply message:

MarketBookReleaseReply {
  oneof response {
    MarketBookReleaseData data = 1;   // getClosedSuccessfully(): bool
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(symbol) string Subscribed instrument to release.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — MarketBookReleaseData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description closed getClosedSuccessfully() boolean true if the subscription closed.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Always pair with MarketBookAdd. Release every symbol you subscribed to.
  • Idempotent-ish. Releasing a symbol you didn't subscribe to simply reports failure — handle the boolean.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.unsubscribeMarketDepth(symbol) returns the boolean directly.

docs.title: 1) Release
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookReleaseRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
console.log('released?', (await account.marketBookRelease(req)).getClosedSuccessfully());

docs.title: 2) Release a basket
docs.text:
for (const sym of ['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'XAUUSD']) {
  const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookReleaseRequest(); req.setSymbol(sym);
  await account.marketBookRelease(req);
}

docs.title: 3) Guaranteed cleanup with finally
docs.text:
const add = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookAddRequest(); add.setSymbol('EURUSD');
await account.marketBookAdd(add);
try {
  // … read the book …
} finally {
  const rel = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookReleaseRequest(); rel.setSymbol('EURUSD');
  await account.marketBookRelease(rel);
}

  const req = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookReleaseRequest();
  req.setSymbol(symbol);
  return (await account.marketBookRelease(req)).getClosedSuccessfully();

docs.title: MT5Account · Market Depth (DOM) — Overview
docs.text: Level-II quotes — the order book. Subscribe to a symbol's Depth of Market, read the current snapshot, then release the subscription. All on mt5_term_api.MarketInfo.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• MarketBookAdd — subscribe to DOM updates for a symbol.
  • MarketBookGet — current market-depth snapshot (book rows).
  • MarketBookRelease — unsubscribe.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
Call add → get (repeatedly) → release. add opens the book on the gateway; get returns the current rows (bids/asks with volume); release closes it.

⚠️ DOM availability. Depth of Market is typically not available for forex pairs on demo accounts; it's meaningful for exchange-traded instruments. marketBookAdd may report the book did not open.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Subscribe to the order book marketBookAdd MarketBookAddData (getOpenedSuccessfully()) Read the book snapshot marketBookGet MarketBookGetData (getMqlBookInfosList()) Unsubscribe marketBookRelease MarketBookReleaseData (getClosedSuccessfully())

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Subscribe first. marketBookGet returns rows only after a successful marketBookAdd.
  • Not every broker/symbol has DOM. Forex on a demo usually has none — marketBookAdd may report getOpenedSuccessfully() === false.
  • Book rows. Each MrpcMqlBookInfo has getType() (level type — MQL5 ENUM_BOOK_TYPE: 1 = sell, 2 = buy, 3/4 = sell/buy market), getPrice(), getVolume(), getVolumeReal().
  • Symbol in Market Watch. Add it with symbolSelect first.
  • Always release. Call marketBookRelease when done to free the subscription.

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Subscribe to Market Depth
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const addReq = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookAddRequest();
addReq.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const added = await account.marketBookAdd(addReq);
console.log(added.getOpenedSuccessfully() ? '✅ Subscribed to EURUSD DOM' : '❌ DOM not available');

// Read the current order book, split by side
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const getReq = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookGetRequest();
getReq.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const rows = (await account.marketBookGet(getReq)).getMqlBookInfosList();

for (const r of rows) {
  const side = r.getType() === 2 ? 'BUY ' : 'SELL'; // 2 = buy, 1 = sell
  console.log(`${side} ${r.getPrice()}: ${r.getVolumeReal()} lots`);
}

// Order-book imbalance, then release
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const getReq = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookGetRequest();
getReq.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const rows = (await account.marketBookGet(getReq)).getMqlBookInfosList();

let buyVol = 0, sellVol = 0;
for (const r of rows) (r.getType() === 2 ? (buyVol += r.getVolumeReal()) : (sellVol += r.getVolumeReal()));
console.log(buyVol > sellVol ? '📈 Bullish pressure' : '📉 Bearish pressure');

const relReq = new MarketInfoPb.MarketBookReleaseRequest();
relReq.setSymbol('EURUSD');
await account.marketBookRelease(relReq);

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Friendly layer: MT5Service.subscribeMarketDepth / getMarketDepth / unsubscribeMarketDepth.

docs.title: MT5Account · Additional Methods — Overview
docs.text:
Deeper symbol data that doesn't fit the basic info group: the full contract spec in bulk, tick value & size for P&L, margin rates, and trading / quote sessions.

symbolParamsMany / tickValueWithSize live on mt5_term_api.AccountHelper; the margin-rate and session methods on mt5_term_api.MarketInfo.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• SymbolParamsMany — full contract spec (~30 fields) for one or all symbols in a single call.
  • TickValueWithSize — tick value / tick size / contract size for several symbols — the inputs for client-side P&L and sizing.
  • SymbolInfoMarginRate — initial / maintenance margin rates for a symbol and order type.
  • SymbolInfoSessionQuote — quote-session times for a weekday.
  • SymbolInfoSessionTrade — trade-session times for a weekday.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• Need everything about a symbol? → symbolParamsMany (one call, ~30 fields) instead of many symbolInfo* calls.
  • Computing P&L / sizing yourself? → tickValueWithSize + the symbol's point.
  • Margin per lot? → symbolInfoMarginRate.
  • When does the symbol trade? → symbolInfoSessionTrade / symbolInfoSessionQuote.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Key inputs Full contract spec (one / all) symbolParamsMany SymbolParamsManyData (getSymbolInfosList() → SymbolParameters) optional symbol Tick value / size for P&L tickValueWithSize TickValueWithSizeData (getSymbolTickSizeInfosList() → TickSizeSymbol) setSymbolNamesList([...]) Margin rates for an order type symbolInfoMarginRate SymbolInfoMarginRateData (getInitialMarginRate(), getMaintenanceMarginRate()) setSymbol, setOrderType Quote-session times for a weekday symbolInfoSessionQuote SymbolInfoSessionQuoteData (getFrom(), getTo()) setSymbol, setDayOfWeek, setSessionIndex Trade-session times for a weekday symbolInfoSessionTrade SymbolInfoSessionTradeData (getFrom(), getTo()) setSymbol, setDayOfWeek, setSessionIndex

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• symbolParamsMany is the efficient path. One call returns the full spec (~30 fields) for one symbol (pass the name) or all symbols (omit it) — cheaper than many symbolInfo* round-trips.
  • Session times are seconds since midnight. getFrom() / getTo() are offsets within the day (server time), not timestamps — divide by 3600 for the hour.
  • Day of week. setDayOfWeek(n) — 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday.
  • Session index. Most symbols have one session (index 0); some split day/night into several.
  • Tick-value getters are lowercase. TickSizeSymbol uses getTradetickvalue(), getTradeticksize(), getTradecontractsize() — not camelCase.
  • Margin rates are multipliers. symbolInfoMarginRate can differ per order type (BUY/SELL).

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Margin rates for a symbol + order type
import { MarketInfoPb, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOrderType(TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
const d = await account.symbolInfoMarginRate(req);
console.log(`Initial: ${d.getInitialMarginRate()}, Maintenance: ${d.getMaintenanceMarginRate()}`);

// Trading-session times for Monday (seconds since midnight → hours)
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setDayOfWeek(1);   // Monday
req.setSessionIndex(0);
const s = await account.symbolInfoSessionTrade(req);
console.log(`Mon session: ${(s.getFrom() / 3600).toFixed(2)}h → ${(s.getTo() / 3600).toFixed(2)}h`);

// Complete symbol parameters — one symbol
const d = await account.symbolParamsMany('EURUSD');
const s = d.getSymbolInfosList()[0];
console.log(`${s.getName()}: Bid=${s.getBid()}, Ask=${s.getAsk()}, Digits=${s.getDigits()}, Point=${s.getPoint()}`);
console.log(`Volume: ${s.getVolumeMin()}–${s.getVolumeMax()} (step ${s.getVolumeStep()}), contract ${s.getTradeContractSize()}`);

// Batch a set of majors from one all-symbols call
const majors = new Set(['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'USDJPY', 'USDCHF', 'AUDUSD', 'USDCAD', 'NZDUSD']);
const all = await account.symbolParamsMany();
for (const sp of all.getSymbolInfosList()) {
  if (!majors.has(sp.getName())) continue;
  console.log(`${sp.getName().padEnd(8)} bid=${sp.getBid()} ask=${sp.getAsk()} spread=${sp.getSpread()}`);
}

// Tick value & size for P&L / sizing
import { AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new AccountHelperPb.TickValueWithSizeRequest();
req.setSymbolNamesList(['EURUSD', 'XAUUSD']);
for (const i of (await account.tickValueWithSize(req)).getSymbolTickSizeInfosList()) {
  console.log(`${i.getName()}: tickValue=${i.getTradetickvalue()}, tickSize=${i.getTradeticksize()}, contract=${i.getTradecontractsize()}`);
}

docs.title: 📐 Getting Margin Rates (SymbolInfoMarginRate)
docs.text:
Request: the initial / maintenance margin rates for a symbol and order type (SymbolInfoMarginRateData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolInfoMarginRate(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolInfoMarginRate (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolInfoMarginRate(SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest) → SymbolInfoMarginRateReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolInfoMarginRate(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the margin-rate multipliers for a symbol + order type.
  • Why you need it. Margin per lot depends on the order type (buy vs sell can differ); these are the multipliers the broker applies.
  • Sanity check. Rates are typically 1.0 on FX majors.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Understand how much margin a side will cost before trading.
  • Combine with OrderCalcMargin for exact figures.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build a SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest with the symbol and order type.
  2. Call account.symbolInfoMarginRate(req).
  3. Read getInitialMarginRate() and getMaintenanceMarginRate().
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOrderType(TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
const d = await account.symbolInfoMarginRate(req);
console.log(d.getInitialMarginRate(), d.getMaintenanceMarginRate());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Margin rates for a symbol + order type. Pass a built request. Returns raw data.
  symbolInfoMarginRate(req: any /* SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolInfoMarginRateData */>;
}

Request setters: setSymbol(string), setOrderType(TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE).

Reply message:

SymbolInfoMarginRateReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolInfoMarginRateData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(symbol) string Instrument. setOrderType(type) TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE Order type (buy/sell can differ).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolInfoMarginRateData
docs.text: Field JS accessor Type Description initial margin rate getInitialMarginRate() number Multiplier for the initial margin. maintenance margin rate getMaintenanceMarginRate() number Multiplier for the maintenance margin.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Rate ≠ amount. These are multipliers; for the money figure use OrderCalcMargin.
  • Check both sides. Query BUY and SELL if the instrument has asymmetric rates.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getSymbolMarginRate(symbol, orderType) returns a mapped SymbolMarginRate.

docs.title: 1) Rates for a BUY
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD'); req.setOrderType(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
const d = await account.symbolInfoMarginRate(req);
console.log('initial', d.getInitialMarginRate(), 'maintenance', d.getMaintenanceMarginRate());

docs.title: 2) Compare buy vs sell
docs.text:
const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;
async function rate(type: number) {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest(); r.setSymbol('EURUSD'); r.setOrderType(type);
  return (await account.symbolInfoMarginRate(r)).getInitialMarginRate();
}
console.log('buy', await rate(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY), 'sell', await rate(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_SELL));

docs.title: 3) A reusable helper
docs.text:
function marginRate(account: MT5Account, symbol: string, type: number) {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest(); r.setSymbol(symbol); r.setOrderType(type);
  return account.symbolInfoMarginRate(r);
}

docs.title: Rate summary
docs.text:
async function rateSummary(account: MT5Account, symbol: string) {
  const OT = TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE;
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoMarginRateRequest();
  r.setSymbol(symbol); r.setOrderType(OT.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);

docs.title: 🕑 Getting Quote Sessions (SymbolInfoSessionQuote)
docs.text:
Request: the quote-session start/end times for a symbol on a given weekday (SymbolInfoSessionQuoteData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolInfoSessionQuote(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolInfoSessionQuote (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolInfoSessionQuote(SymbolInfoSessionQuoteRequest) → SymbolInfoSessionQuoteReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolInfoSessionQuote(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning when quotes flow for a symbol on a weekday — a symbol can have several quote sessions per day (index 0, 1, …).
  • Why you need it. Know when prices update before you rely on a fresh quote.
  • Sanity check. getFrom() / getTo() are seconds from midnight.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Display a symbol's quoting hours.
  • Decide whether a stale quote is expected (outside a session).

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build a SymbolInfoSessionQuoteRequest with the symbol, weekday (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday) and session index.
  2. Call account.symbolInfoSessionQuote(req).
  3. Read getFrom() / getTo() — seconds since midnight (server time).
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionQuoteRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setDayOfWeek(1);     // Monday
req.setSessionIndex(0);
const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionQuote(req);
console.log(d.getFrom(), d.getTo());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Quote session [from,to] for a symbol/weekday/index. Pass a built request. Raw data.
  symbolInfoSessionQuote(req: any /* SymbolInfoSessionQuoteRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolInfoSessionQuoteData */>;
}

Request setters: setSymbol(string), setDayOfWeek(number) (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday), setSessionIndex(number) (0-based).

Reply message:

SymbolInfoSessionQuoteReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolInfoSessionQuoteData data = 1;   // getFrom(), getTo()
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(symbol) string Instrument. setDayOfWeek(day) number 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. setSessionIndex(i) number 0-based session index.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolInfoSessionQuoteData
docs.text:
Field JS accessor Type Description from getFrom() number Session start — seconds since midnight. to getTo() number Session end — seconds since midnight.

Times are seconds from midnight (server time), not a Timestamp. 08:00 → 28800.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Multiple sessions. Increment sessionIndex until the call errors to enumerate all sessions of a day.
  • Server time. The seconds are in the broker's time zone — see AccountInfo.utcServerShiftMinutes.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getSymbolSessionQuote(symbol, dayOfWeek, index) → SessionTime.

docs.title: 1) Monday's first quote session
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionQuoteRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD'); req.setDayOfWeek(1); req.setSessionIndex(0);
const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionQuote(req);
const hhmm = (s: number) => `${String(Math.floor(s / 3600)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`;
console.log('quotes', hhmm(d.getFrom()), '→', hhmm(d.getTo()));

docs.title: 2) Enumerate a day's sessions
docs.text:
async function quoteSessions(account: MT5Account, sym: string, day: number) {
  const out: Array<{ from: number; to: number }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; ; i++) {
    try {
      const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionQuoteRequest();
      r.setSymbol(sym); r.setDayOfWeek(day); r.setSessionIndex(i);
      const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionQuote(r);
      out.push({ from: d.getFrom(), to: d.getTo() });
    } catch { break; }
  }
  return out;
}

docs.title: 3) Is it quoting now?
docs.text:
const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionQuoteRequest();
r.setSymbol('EURUSD'); r.setDayOfWeek(new Date().getUTCDay()); r.setSessionIndex(0);
const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionQuote(r);
const nowSec = new Date().getUTCHours() * 3600 + new Date().getUTCMinutes() * 60;
console.log('in quote session?', nowSec >= d.getFrom() && nowSec <= d.getTo());

docs.title: Session helper
docs.text:
function quoteSession(account: MT5Account, sym: string, day: number, index = 0) {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionQuoteRequest();
  r.setSymbol(sym); r.setDayOfWeek(day); r.setSessionIndex(index);
  return account.symbolInfoSessionQuote(r);
}
