docs.text:
• SymbolInfoSessionTrade · SymbolInfoTick
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getSymbolSessionQuote → SessionTime.

docs.title: 🕒 Getting Trade Sessions (SymbolInfoSessionTrade)
docs.text:
Request: the trade-session start/end times for a symbol on a given weekday (SymbolInfoSessionTradeData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolInfoSessionTrade(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolInfoSessionTrade (in mt5-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolInfoSessionTrade(SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest) → SymbolInfoSessionTradeReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolInfoSessionTrade(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning when a symbol is tradable on a weekday — a symbol can have several trade sessions per day (index 0, 1, …).
  • Why you need it. Avoid 10018 MARKET_CLOSED by checking you're inside a trade session before sending an order.
  • Sanity check. getFrom() / getTo() are seconds from midnight.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Gate order sending to a symbol's trading hours.
  • Explain a 10018 rejection (outside a session).

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build a SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest with the symbol, weekday and session index.
  2. Call account.symbolInfoSessionTrade(req).
  3. Read getFrom() / getTo() — seconds since midnight (server time).
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setDayOfWeek(1);     // Monday
req.setSessionIndex(0);
const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionTrade(req);
console.log(d.getFrom(), d.getTo());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Trade session [from,to] for a symbol/weekday/index. Pass a built request. Raw data.
  symbolInfoSessionTrade(req: any /* SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolInfoSessionTradeData */>;
}

Request setters: setSymbol(string), setDayOfWeek(number) (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday), setSessionIndex(number) (0-based).

Reply message:

SymbolInfoSessionTradeReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolInfoSessionTradeData data = 1;   // getFrom(), getTo()
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(symbol) string Instrument. setDayOfWeek(day) number 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. setSessionIndex(i) number 0-based session index.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolInfoSessionTradeData
docs.text:
Field JS accessor Type Description from getFrom() number Trade-session start — seconds since midnight. to getTo() number Trade-session end — seconds since midnight.

Times are seconds from midnight (server time). 22:00 → 79200.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Quote ≠ trade. A symbol may quote outside the hours it can be traded — check this, not SymbolInfoSessionQuote, before an order.
  • Multiple sessions. Increment sessionIndex until the call errors to list a day's sessions.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getSymbolSessionTrade(symbol, dayOfWeek, index) → SessionTime.

docs.title: 1) Monday's first trade session
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD'); req.setDayOfWeek(1); req.setSessionIndex(0);
const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionTrade(req);
console.log('tradable', d.getFrom(), '→', d.getTo(), '(seconds from midnight)');

docs.title: 2) Is it tradable now?
docs.text:
const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest();
r.setSymbol('EURUSD'); r.setDayOfWeek(new Date().getUTCDay()); r.setSessionIndex(0);
const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionTrade(r);
const nowSec = new Date().getUTCHours() * 3600 + new Date().getUTCMinutes() * 60;
if (nowSec < d.getFrom() || nowSec > d.getTo()) console.warn('market likely closed — expect 10018');

docs.title: 3) Enumerate a day's trade sessions
docs.text:
async function tradeSessions(account: MT5Account, sym: string, day: number) {
  const out: Array<{ from: number; to: number }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; ; i++) {
    try {
      const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest();
      r.setSymbol(sym); r.setDayOfWeek(day); r.setSessionIndex(i);
      const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionTrade(r);
      out.push({ from: d.getFrom(), to: d.getTo() });
    } catch { break; }
  }
  return out;
}

docs.title: Trade-window guard before an order
docs.text:
async function marketOpen(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoSessionTradeRequest();
  r.setSymbol(sym); r.setDayOfWeek(new Date().getUTCDay()); r.setSessionIndex(0);
  try {
    const d = await account.symbolInfoSessionTrade(r);
    const nowSec = new Date().getUTCHours() * 3600 + new Date().getUTCMinutes() * 60;
    return nowSec >= d.getFrom() && nowSec <= d.getTo();
  } catch { return false; }
}

docs.text:
• SymbolInfoSessionQuote · OrderSend
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getSymbolSessionTrade → SessionTime.

docs.title: 🧾 Getting Full Symbol Parameters
docs.text:
Request: the full contract spec (~40 fields) of one or all symbols (SymbolParamsManyData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.symbolParamsMany(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: SymbolParamsMany (in mt5-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: SymbolParamsMany(SymbolParamsManyRequest) → SymbolParamsManyReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.symbolParamsMany(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the complete contract spec per symbol — digits, point, contract size, volume limits, swaps, currencies, trade modes…
  • Why you need it. Format prices, size positions and compute P&L with all the rules in a single call.
  • Sanity check. getSymbolInfosList() has at least one entry.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Pull everything about a symbol at once instead of many symbolInfo* reads.
  • Cache specs for a basket of instruments.
  • With no symbol, snapshot every symbol the broker exposes.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Call account.symbolParamsMany('EURUSD') for one symbol, or account.symbolParamsMany() for all.
  2. Iterate getSymbolInfosList() → SymbolParameters.
  3. Read the getters you need (getDigits(), getPoint(), getTradeContractSize()…).
const d = await account.symbolParamsMany('EURUSD');
const s = d.getSymbolInfosList().find((x) => x.getName() === 'EURUSD') ?? d.getSymbolInfosList()[0];
console.log(s.getDigits(), s.getPoint(), s.getTradeContractSize());

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Full spec of one symbol (pass the name) or all symbols (omit it). Returns raw SymbolParamsManyData.
  symbolParamsMany(symbol?: string, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolParamsManyData */>;
}

Request message: SymbolParamsManyRequest — setSymbolName, setSortType, setPageNumber, setItemsPerPage (the SDK sets the name from your argument).

Reply message:

SymbolParamsManyReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolParamsManyData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description symbol string? One symbol; omit to return all symbols (heavier). timeoutMs number? Per-call deadline (default 120 s for the all-symbols case).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolParamsManyData
docs.text:
getSymbolInfosList() → array of SymbolParameters; plus getSymbolsTotal(), getPageNumber(), getItemsPerPage().

SymbolParameters — key getters:

Getter Description getName() Symbol name. getDigits() / getPoint() Decimals / smallest increment. getBid() / getAsk() / getSpread() Current prices / spread. getTradeContractSize() Contract size. getTradeTickSize() / getTradeTickValue() Tick size / value (for P&L). getVolumeMin() / getVolumeMax() / getVolumeStep() / getVolumeLimit() Volume rules. getSwapLong() / getSwapShort() Swap rates. getTradeMode() / getTradeCalcMode() / getTradeExeMode() Trade modes. getFillingModeList() Allowed filling modes. getCurrencyBase() / getCurrencyProfit() / getCurrencyMargin() Currencies. getSymDescription() / getPath() Description / tree path. getVisible() / getSelect() / getExist() Market Watch flags.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• All symbols is heavy. Omitting the name can return thousands of specs — prefer a single symbol unless you need the whole list.
  • One call beats many. Everything SymbolInfoDouble/Integer/String returns, in one record.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.getSymbolParams(symbol) / getSymbolParamsMany() return mapped SymbolParams.

docs.title: 1) One symbol's spec
docs.text:
const d = await account.symbolParamsMany('EURUSD');
const s = d.getSymbolInfosList()[0];
console.log(`digits ${s.getDigits()}  point ${s.getPoint()}  contract ${s.getTradeContractSize()}`);

docs.title: 2) Volume rules
docs.text:
const s = (await account.symbolParamsMany('EURUSD')).getSymbolInfosList()[0];
console.log('volMin', s.getVolumeMin(), 'volStep', s.getVolumeStep(), 'volMax', s.getVolumeMax());

docs.title: 3) Currencies & description
docs.text:
const s = (await account.symbolParamsMany('EURUSD')).getSymbolInfosList()[0];
console.log(`${s.getSymDescription()} — ${s.getCurrencyBase()}/${s.getCurrencyProfit()}  margin in ${s.getCurrencyMargin()}`);

docs.title: 4) All symbols (heavier)
docs.text:
const all = await account.symbolParamsMany();
console.log('symbols:', all.getSymbolInfosList().length);

docs.title: 5) Build a spec cache
docs.text:
async function specOf(account: MT5Account, sym: string) {
  const s = (await account.symbolParamsMany(sym)).getSymbolInfosList()[0];
  return { digits: s.getDigits(), point: s.getPoint(), volMin: s.getVolumeMin(), volStep: s.getVolumeStep() };
}

docs.title: Pip size from the spec
docs.text:
async function pipSize(account: MT5Account, sym: string): Promise<number> {
  const s = (await account.symbolParamsMany(sym)).getSymbolInfosList()[0];
  return s.getPoint() * (s.getDigits() === 3 || s.getDigits() === 5 ? 10 : 1);
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• TickValueWithSize · SymbolInfoDouble
  • Friendly layer: MT5Service.getSymbolParams → SymbolParams · MT5Sugar.getSymbolInfo.

docs.title: 🪙 Getting Tick Value & Size
docs.text:
Request: tick value, tick size and contract size for several symbols (TickValueWithSizeData), on MT5 — the inputs for client-side P&L and sizing.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.tickValueWithSize(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: TickValueWithSize (in mt5-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: TickValueWithSize(TickValueWithSizeRequest) → TickValueWithSizeReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.tickValueWithSize(request, metadata, opts)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning, per requested symbol, the tick value / tick size / contract size.
  • Why you need it. Turn a price move into account-currency P&L, or size a position by risk.
  • Sanity check. getSymbolTickSizeInfosList() has one entry per requested symbol.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Compute "money per pip per lot" for several symbols in one round-trip.
  • Feed a risk-based position sizer.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build a TickValueWithSizeRequest with the symbol names.
  2. Call account.tickValueWithSize(req).
  3. Iterate getSymbolTickSizeInfosList() → TickSizeSymbol.
import { MT5Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new AccountHelperPb.TickValueWithSizeRequest();
req.setSymbolNamesList(['EURUSD', 'XAUUSD']);
for (const i of (await account.tickValueWithSize(req)).getSymbolTickSizeInfosList()) {
  console.log(i.getName(), i.getTradetickvalue(), i.getTradeticksize());
}

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Tick value/size/contract for several symbols. Pass a built request (setSymbolNamesList). Raw data.
  tickValueWithSize(req: any /* TickValueWithSizeRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* TickValueWithSizeData */>;
}

Request message: TickValueWithSizeRequest — setSymbolNamesList(string[]).

Reply message:

TickValueWithSizeReply {
  oneof response {
    TickValueWithSizeData data = 1;   // getSymbolTickSizeInfosList(): TickSizeSymbol[]
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbolNamesList(names) string[] Symbols to query.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — TickValueWithSizeData
docs.text:
getSymbolTickSizeInfosList() → array of TickSizeSymbol:

Getter Description getName() Symbol name. getTradetickvalue() Money value of one tick. getTradetickvalueprofit() Tick value on the profit side. getTradetickvalueloss() Tick value on the loss side. getTradeticksize() Minimal price change per tick. getTradecontractsize() Contract size. getIndex() Position in the request order.

Note the lowercase getters (getTradetickvalue, not getTradeTickValue) — they follow the proto field names.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Value per pip per lot ≈ (pipSize / tickSize) × tickValue.
  • Batch them. One call for your whole watchlist beats one per symbol.
  • Profit vs loss tick value can differ for some instruments — use the side you need.

docs.title: 1) Tick value & size for a basket
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new AccountHelperPb.TickValueWithSizeRequest();
req.setSymbolNamesList(['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'XAUUSD']);
for (const i of (await account.tickValueWithSize(req)).getSymbolTickSizeInfosList()) {
  console.log(`${i.getName()}  tickVal ${i.getTradetickvalue()}  tickSize ${i.getTradeticksize()}`);
}

docs.title: 2) Money value of a 1-tick move
docs.text:
const req = new AccountHelperPb.TickValueWithSizeRequest();
req.setSymbolNamesList(['EURUSD']);
const i = (await account.tickValueWithSize(req)).getSymbolTickSizeInfosList()[0];
console.log('per tick per lot:', i.getTradetickvalue());

docs.title: 3) Build a value map
docs.text:
async function tickValues(account: MT5Account, symbols: string[]) {
  const req = new AccountHelperPb.TickValueWithSizeRequest();
  req.setSymbolNamesList(symbols);
  const out = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const i of (await account.tickValueWithSize(req)).getSymbolTickSizeInfosList()) {
    out.set(i.getName(), i.getTradetickvalue());
  }
  return out;
}

docs.title: Risk-based lot size
docs.text:
async function sizeByRisk(account: MT5Account, symbol: string, riskMoney: number, stopPips: number, pipSize: number): Promise<number> {
  const req = new AccountHelperPb.TickValueWithSizeRequest();
  req.setSymbolNamesList([symbol]);
  const i = (await account.tickValueWithSize(req)).getSymbolTickSizeInfosList()[0];
  const valuePerPipPerLot = (pipSize / i.getTradeticksize()) * i.getTradetickvalue();
  return riskMoney / (stopPips * valuePerPipPerLot);
}

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Position P&L (OnPositionProfit)
docs.text:
Subscribe: periodic open-position P&L snapshots on a timer (OnPositionProfitData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.onPositionProfit(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnPositionProfit (in mt5-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnPositionProfit(OnPositionProfitRequest) → stream OnPositionProfitReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionServiceClient.onPositionProfit(request, metadata)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that pushes, on a timer you set, the current profit of your open positions (plus which appeared/changed/closed).
  • Why you need it. A live P&L ticker without computing it yourself.
  • Sanity check. With positions open, updates arrive every timerPeriodMilliseconds.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Drive a real-time P&L widget.
  • Trigger logic when a position crosses a profit/loss threshold.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build an OnPositionProfitRequest with the timer period (and setIgnoreEmptyData).
  2. Call account.onPositionProfit(req, callback, onError?).
  3. Iterate getUpdatedPositionsList() (and new/deleted) → OnPositionProfitPositionInfo.
import { SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnPositionProfitRequest();
req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(1000);
req.setIgnoreEmptyData(true);

const sub = account.onPositionProfit(req, (data) => {
  for (const p of data.getUpdatedPositionsList()) {
    console.log(`#${p.getTicket()} ${p.getPositionSymbol()} ${p.getProfit()}`);
  }
});

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, SubscriptionsPb, Subscription } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Stream periodic position P&L. Pass a built request (timer period). Returns a Subscription.
  onPositionProfit(
    req: any /* OnPositionProfitRequest */,
    callback: (data: any /* OnPositionProfitData */) => void,
    onError?: (e: Error) => void,
  ): Subscription;
}

Request setters: setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(number), setIgnoreEmptyData(boolean).

Reply message (streamed):

OnPositionProfitReply {
  oneof response {
    OnPositionProfitData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description req OnPositionProfitRequest Timer period + ignore-empty flag. callback (data) => void Per snapshot. onError (e) => void Optional.

docs.title: ⬆️ Payload — OnPositionProfitData
docs.text:
Field JS accessor Description type getType() Snapshot/event type. new positions getNewPositionsList() Positions that appeared. updated positions getUpdatedPositionsList() Positions whose P&L changed. deleted positions getDeletedPositionsList() Positions that closed. account info getAccountInfo() Account snapshot.

Each list element is OnPositionProfitPositionInfo: getIndex(), getTicket(), getProfit(), getPositionSymbol().

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Set a sane timer. 1000 ms is a smooth ticker; very small periods add load.
  • setIgnoreEmptyData(true) skips empty snapshots when nothing changed.
  • Always unsubscribe().
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.streamPositionProfits.

docs.title: 1) Live P&L per position
docs.text:
import { SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnPositionProfitRequest();
req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(1000);
req.setIgnoreEmptyData(true);

const sub = account.onPositionProfit(req, (data) => {
  for (const p of data.getUpdatedPositionsList()) {
    console.log(`#${p.getTicket()} ${p.getPositionSymbol()} P&L ${p.getProfit().toFixed(2)}`);
  }
});

docs.title: 2) Total floating P&L ticker
docs.text:
const sub = account.onPositionProfit(req, (data) => {
  const total = data.getUpdatedPositionsList().reduce((s, p) => s + p.getProfit(), 0);
  console.log('floating:', total.toFixed(2));
});

docs.title: 3) Alert on a threshold
docs.text:
const sub = account.onPositionProfit(req, (data) => {
  for (const p of data.getUpdatedPositionsList()) {
    if (p.getProfit() <= -50) console.warn(`#${p.getTicket()} down ${p.getProfit()}`);
  }
});

docs.title: P&L map kept current
docs.text:
const pnl = new Map<number, number>();
function watchPnl(account: MT5Account) {
  const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnPositionProfitRequest();
  req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(1000); req.setIgnoreEmptyData(true);
  return account.onPositionProfit(req, (data) => {
    for (const p of data.getUpdatedPositionsList()) pnl.set(p.getTicket(), p.getProfit());
    for (const p of data.getDeletedPositionsList()) pnl.delete(p.getTicket());
  });
}

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Ticket Snapshots (OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets)
docs.text:
Subscribe: periodic snapshots of your open position & pending-order tickets on a timer (OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTicketsData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets (in mt5-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTicketsRequest) → stream OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTicketsReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionServiceClient.onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(request, metadata)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that pushes, on your timer, the current lists of open position tickets and pending-order tickets.
  • Why you need it. A cheap heartbeat to know what is open — pull detail only when the set changes.
  • Sanity check. Both lists reflect what you have open.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• A lightweight "is anything open?" monitor.
  • Diff against a previous snapshot to detect opens/closes.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Build a request with the timer period.
  2. Call account.onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(req, callback, onError?).

import { SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTicketsRequest();
req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(2000);

const sub = account.onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(req, (data) => {
  console.log('positions:', data.getPositionTicketsList());
  console.log('pendings :', data.getPendingOrderTicketsList());
});

docs.title: 1) Heartbeat print
docs.text:
import { SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTicketsRequest();
req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(2000);
const sub = account.onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(req, (data) => {

docs.title: 2) Detect a new position
docs.text:
let prev = new Set<number>();
const sub = account.onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(req, (data) => {
  const now = new Set(data.getPositionTicketsList());
  for (const t of now) if (!prev.has(t)) console.log('opened', t);

docs.title: Keep a live ticket set
docs.text:
const openPositions = new Set<number>();
function watchTickets(account: MT5Account) {
  const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTicketsRequest();
  req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(2000);
  return account.onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(req, (data) => {
    openPositions.clear();
    for (const t of data.getPositionTicketsList()) openPositions.add(t);
  });

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Ticks (OnSymbolTick)
docs.text:
Subscribe: live Bid/Ask ticks for one or more symbols (OnSymbolTickData per tick), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.onSymbolTick(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnSymbolTick (in mt5-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnSymbolTick(OnSymbolTickRequest) → stream OnSymbolTickReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionServiceClient.onSymbolTick(request, metadata)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that pushes a tick whenever a subscribed symbol's price changes.
  • Why you need it. React to the market without polling SymbolInfoTick.
  • Sanity check. You start receiving ticks within seconds for an active symbol.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Drive live dashboards, signals or order logic off real-time prices.
  • Keep the latest bid/ask cached for several symbols.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Call account.onSymbolTick(symbols, callback, onError?).
  2. Read each payload's getSymbolTick() → MrpcSubscriptionMqlTick.
  3. Keep the Subscription and call unsubscribe() when done.
const sub = account.onSymbolTick(['EURUSD'], (data) => {
  const t = data.getSymbolTick();
  console.log(t.getSymbol(), t.getBid(), t.getAsk());
});
setTimeout(() => sub.unsubscribe(), 30_000);

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, Subscription } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Stream live ticks for the given symbols. Returns a Subscription; call unsubscribe() to stop.
  onSymbolTick(
    symbols: string[],
    callback: (data: any /* OnSymbolTickData */) => void,
    onError?: (e: Error) => void,
  ): Subscription;
}

Request message: OnSymbolTickRequest — setSymbolNamesList(string[]) (built from your argument).

Reply message (streamed):

OnSymbolTickReply {
  oneof response {
    OnSymbolTickData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description symbols string[] Symbols to stream. callback (data) => void Called per tick with the raw OnSymbolTickData. onError (e) => void Optional; gateway/terminal errors as MrpcError.

docs.title: ⬆️ Payload — OnSymbolTickData
docs.text:
getSymbolTick() → MrpcSubscriptionMqlTick:

Getter Description getSymbol() Instrument. getBid() / getAsk() Best prices. getLast() Last deal price. getVolume() / getVolumeReal() Tick volume. getTime() Tick time (Timestamp — .getSeconds()). getTimeMsc() Milliseconds epoch. getFlags() Tick flags.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Always unsubscribe(). An un-cancelled stream leaks — tie it to teardown.
  • Keep callbacks light. They run on the single event loop; heavy work stalls other streams. See Concurrency Model.
  • Stream ends surface via onError (MrpcError('tick stream ended')); reconnect + resubscribe to resume.
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.streamTicks maps each tick to a Quote.

docs.title: 1) Stream one symbol
docs.text:
const sub = account.onSymbolTick(['EURUSD'], (data) => {
  const t = data.getSymbolTick();
  console.log(`${t.getSymbol()} ${t.getBid()}/${t.getAsk()}`);
}, (e) => console.error('stream error:', e.message));

docs.title: 2) Several symbols
docs.text:
const sub = account.onSymbolTick(['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'XAUUSD'], (data) => {
  const t = data.getSymbolTick();
  console.log(t.getSymbol(), t.getBid());
});

docs.title: 3) Cache the latest prices
docs.text:
const latest = new Map<string, { bid: number; ask: number }>();
const sub = account.onSymbolTick(['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD'], (data) => {
  const t = data.getSymbolTick();
  latest.set(t.getSymbol(), { bid: t.getBid(), ask: t.getAsk() });
});

docs.title: 4) Stop after N ticks
docs.text:
let n = 0;
const sub = account.onSymbolTick(['EURUSD'], (data) => {
  console.log(data.getSymbolTick().getBid());
  if (++n >= 10) sub.unsubscribe();
});

docs.title: Promise that resolves on the first tick
docs.text:
function firstTick(account: MT5Account, symbol: string): Promise<{ bid: number; ask: number }> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const sub = account.onSymbolTick([symbol], (data) => {
      const t = data.getSymbolTick();
      sub.unsubscribe();
      resolve({ bid: t.getBid(), ask: t.getAsk() });
    });
  });
}

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Trade Events (OnTrade)
docs.text:
Subscribe: trade events — something in your account changed: orders, positions or deals (OnTradeData per event), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.onTrade(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnTrade (in mt5-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnTrade(OnTradeRequest) → stream OnTradeReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionServiceClient.onTrade(request, metadata)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that fires whenever the trading state changes (an order placed/filled/removed, a position opened/closed…).
  • Why you need it. Keep your app's view of positions/orders in sync without polling.
  • Sanity check. You receive an event shortly after you trade.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• React to fills and closes as they happen.
  • Invalidate a cached book and re-pull OpenedOrders on change.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Call account.onTrade(callback, onError?).
  2. Inspect each payload's getType() and getEventData(); getAccountInfo() carries a fresh account snapshot.
  3. Keep the Subscription and unsubscribe() when done.
const sub = account.onTrade((data) => {
  console.log('trade event, type', data.getType());
});

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT5Account, Subscription } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

class MT5Account {
  // Stream trade events. Returns a Subscription; call unsubscribe() to stop.
  onTrade(
    callback: (data: any /* OnTradeData */) => void,
    onError?: (e: Error) => void,
  ): Subscription;
}

Reply message (streamed):

OnTradeReply {

    OnTradeData data = 1;
    Error error = 2;
  }

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description callback (data) => void Called per event with the raw OnTradeData. onError (e) => void Optional; errors as MrpcError.

docs.text: Field JS accessor Description type getType() Event type. event data getEventData() Details of what changed (new/updated/removed orders, positions, deals). account info getAccountInfo() Account snapshot at the event.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Coarse signal. OnTrade says "something changed" — for per-transaction detail use OnTradeTransaction.
  • Re-pull on change. A common pattern is to fetch OpenedOrders when an event arrives.
  • Always unsubscribe().
  • Friendly form. MT5Service.streamTradeUpdates.

docs.title: 1) Log events

  console.log('event type', data.getType());
  const acc = data.getAccountInfo();

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Trade Transactions (OnTradeTransaction)
docs.text:
Subscribe: raw trade-transaction events — the lowest-level view of fills, requests and results (OnTradeTransactionData), on MT5.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT5Account.onTradeTransaction(...) (from @metarpc/nodemt5)
  • gRPC service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnTradeTransaction (in mt5-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnTradeTransaction(OnTradeTransactionRequest) → stream OnTradeTransactionReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionServiceClient.onTradeTransaction(request, metadata)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream mirroring MT5's OnTradeTransaction — each order/deal transaction with its originating request and result.
  • Why you need it. Audit-grade trade tracking: match a request to its deal, watch partial fills, build an order-state machine.
  • Sanity check. A transaction arrives for each fill/modification you make.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Reconcile requests with the deals that executed them.
  • Detect partial fills and state transitions precisely.

docs.title: 📚 Tutorial
docs.text:
1. Call account.onTradeTransaction(callback, onError?).
  2. Inspect getTradeTransaction() → MqlTradeTransaction, plus getTradeRequest() / getTradeResult().
  3. Keep the Subscription and unsubscribe() when done.
const sub = account.onTradeTransaction((data) => {
  const tx = data.getTradeTransaction();
  console.log(tx.getSymbol(), 'deal#', tx.getDealTicket(), 'order#', tx.getOrderTicket());
});

docs.text:

Reply message (streamed):

OnTradeTransactionReply {

Field JS accessor Description type getType() Event type. transaction getTradeTransaction() The MqlTradeTransaction. request getTradeRequest() Originating trade request. result getTradeResult() Trade result (retcode…). account info getAccountInfo() Account snapshot.

  • Match by position id. Use getPositionTicket() to tie transactions to a position.
  • Always unsubscribe().

function logFills(account: MT5Account) {

docs.title: MT5Account · Streaming Methods — Overview
docs.text: Server-streaming subscriptions: live ticks, trade events, periodic P&L, ticket snapshots and trade transactions. All live on mt5_term_api.SubscriptionService.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• OnSymbolTick — live Bid/Ask ticks for one or more symbols.
  • OnTrade — trade events (orders/positions/deals changed).
  • OnPositionProfit — periodic open-position P&L snapshots on a timer.
  • OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets — periodic ticket snapshots on a timer.
  • OnTradeTransaction — raw trade-transaction events (fills, requests, results).

docs.title: 🧰 The subscription model
docs.text:
Every streaming method returns a Subscription — { unsubscribe(): void } — and calls your callback on each payload:

interface Subscription { unsubscribe(): void; }

const sub = account.onSymbolTick(['EURUSD'], (tick) => { /* … */ });
// later:
sub.unsubscribe();
  • Payload is the raw *Data message (same getXxx() accessors as the unary calls).
  • Errors arrive via the optional onError callback; a gateway/terminal error is an MrpcError.
  • The SDK attaches the session guid + api key automatically — just connect() first.

Always keep the returned Subscription and call unsubscribe() when done — an un-cancelled stream leaks.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text: You want… Use Live prices onSymbolTick "Something changed in my account" onTrade A P&L ticker for open positions onPositionProfit A heartbeat list of open tickets onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets Low-level fill/transaction detail onTradeTransaction

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Callback payload Key inputs Live price ticks onSymbolTick OnSymbolTickData (getSymbolTick() → MrpcSubscriptionMqlTick) symbols: string[] "Something changed" trade events onTrade OnTradeData (getType()) (none) Detailed transaction audit onTradeTransaction OnTradeTransactionData (getTradeTransaction()) (none) Periodic P&L of open positions onPositionProfit OnPositionProfitData (getUpdatedPositionsList()) setTimerPeriodMilliseconds, setIgnoreEmptyData Periodic ticket snapshots onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTicketsData setTimerPeriodMilliseconds

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Callbacks, not channels. Each method returns a Subscription and invokes your callback per payload — no manual loop; errors go to the optional onError.
  • Always unsubscribe(). An un-cancelled stream keeps the gRPC call (and terminal) alive.
  • onSymbolTick is high-frequency. Many updates per second per symbol — keep the callback cheap.
  • Timer streams need a period. onPositionProfit / onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets take setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(...); 1000 ms is a smooth ticker.
  • No symbol filter on P&L. onPositionProfit streams all positions — filter by getPositionSymbol() on the client side.
  • onTrade vs onTradeTransaction. onTrade = coarse "state changed"; onTradeTransaction = per-transaction detail (fills, requests, results).

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Live ticks for EURUSD
const sub = account.onSymbolTick(['EURUSD'], (data) => {
  const t = data.getSymbolTick();
  console.log(`${t.getSymbol()}: Bid=${t.getBid()}, Ask=${t.getAsk()}`);
}, (e) => console.error(e.message));
// later: sub.unsubscribe();

// Trade events — re-pull the book on change
const sub = account.onTrade(async (data) => {
  console.log('trade event, type', data.getType());
  const d = await account.openedOrders();
  console.log('positions now:', d.getPositionInfosList().length);
});

// Periodic position P&L (all positions; filter client-side)
import { SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnPositionProfitRequest();
req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(1000);
req.setIgnoreEmptyData(true);
const sub = account.onPositionProfit(req, (data) => {
  for (const p of data.getUpdatedPositionsList()) {
    console.log(`#${p.getTicket()} ${p.getPositionSymbol()} P&L ${p.getProfit().toFixed(2)}`);
  }
});

// Heartbeat of open tickets
import { SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnPositionsAndPendingOrdersTicketsRequest();
req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(2000);
const sub = account.onPositionsAndPendingOrdersTickets(req, (data) => {
  console.log('positions:', data.getPositionTicketsList());
  console.log('pendings :', data.getPendingOrderTicketsList());
});

// Raw transaction log
const sub = account.onTradeTransaction((data) => {
  const tx = data.getTradeTransaction();
  console.log(`tx ${data.getType()} ${tx.getSymbol()} deal#${tx.getDealTicket()} order#${tx.getOrderTicket()}`);
});

// Several streams at once — collect handles, unsubscribe all
const subs = [
  account.onSymbolTick(['EURUSD'], (d) => console.log('[TICK]', d.getSymbolTick().getBid())),
  account.onTrade((d) => console.log('[TRADE] type', d.getType())),
];
// later:
for (const s of subs) s.unsubscribe();

docs.title: MT5Service — Account Methods (Mid-Level API)
docs.text:
4 convenient methods for reading account state — a composed snapshot, plus direct typed property reads — without protobuf ceremony.

🧩 API Layer: MID-LEVEL — a friendly facade over MT5Account that returns plain JS types and typed objects.

Implementation: these methods live in src/MT5Service.ts, wrapping the low-level accountSummary / accountInfo{Double,Integer,String} calls on MT5Account.

Demos: examples/demos/service/04_service_demo.js · examples/demos/run_all.js.

← MT5Service Overview · low-level group ↓

docs.title: 🎯 Why these methods exist
docs.text:
Problem — on MT5Account, a single-property read returns a protobuf *Data object you must unwrap, and the property enum must be looked up:

// Low-level (MT5Account)
import { AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const balance = await account.accountInfoDouble(
  AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType.ACCOUNT_BALANCE,
); // already a number here, but you still carry the enum import everywhere

Solution — MT5Service composes the whole account into one typed object, and still exposes the single-property reads when you need just one value:

// Mid-level (MT5Service)
const a = await service.getAccountSummary();
console.log(a.balance, a.equity, a.currency); // ✅ plain fields, no enums

Advantages

  • ✅ One call → the whole account as a typed AccountInfo object.
  • ✅ Plain JS types (number / string) — no .getXxx() chains.
  • ✅ tradeMode decoded to 'DEMO' | 'CONTEST' | 'REAL', plus the raw tradeModeCode.
  • ✅ Server time already converted to seconds-since-epoch, with the UTC shift for building history windows.

docs.title: 📋 All 4 methods
docs.text: Method Returns Low-level equivalent getAccountSummary() Promise<AccountInfo> accountSummary() + margin doubles, composed getAccountDouble(propertyId) Promise<number> accountInfoDouble(propertyId) getAccountInteger(propertyId) Promise<number> accountInfoInteger(propertyId) getAccountString(propertyId) Promise<string> accountInfoString(propertyId)

docs.title: 📦 AccountInfo (DTO)
docs.text:
Returned by getAccountSummary():

Field Type Description login number Account number. currency string Deposit currency (USD, EUR, …). balance number Balance (without floating P&L). equity number Equity (balance + floating P&L). credit number Credit. margin number Used margin. freeMargin number Free margin. marginLevel number Margin level, %. leverage number Leverage (100 = 1:100). name string Account holder. company string Broker name. server string Trade server (e.g. MetaQuotes-Demo). tradeMode 'DEMO' \| 'CONTEST' \| 'REAL' \| 'UNKNOWN' Decoded account type. tradeModeCode number Raw trade-mode enum value. serverTime number Broker server time — seconds since epoch. utcServerShiftMinutes number serverTime = utc + shift·60. Use it to build server-time history windows.

serverTime is the broker's wall clock; subtract utcServerShiftMinutes·60 to get real UTC. The history methods accept a Date directly and do this for you.

docs.title: 1) getAccountSummary(): Promise<AccountInfo>
docs.text:
Everything about the account in one round-trip. Composes accountSummary with the margin/level fields and decodes the trade-mode enum.

const a = await service.getAccountSummary();
console.log(`${a.name} #${a.login} on ${a.server}`);
console.log(`Balance ${a.balance} ${a.currency} · Equity ${a.equity} · Free ${a.freeMargin}`);

docs.title: 2) getAccountDouble(propertyId): Promise<number>
docs.text:
One numeric property, already unwrapped. Pass an AccountInfoDoublePropertyType:

ACCOUNT_BALANCE · ACCOUNT_CREDIT · ACCOUNT_PROFIT · ACCOUNT_EQUITY · ACCOUNT_MARGIN · ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE · ACCOUNT_MARGIN_LEVEL · ACCOUNT_MARGIN_SO_CALL · ACCOUNT_MARGIN_SO_SO · ACCOUNT_MARGIN_INITIAL · ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MAINTENANCE · ACCOUNT_ASSETS · ACCOUNT_LIABILITIES · ACCOUNT_COMMISSION_BLOCKED (14 total).

import { AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const D = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType;
const profit = await service.getAccountDouble(D.ACCOUNT_PROFIT);

docs.title: 3) getAccountInteger(propertyId): Promise<number>
docs.text:
One integer property. Pass an AccountInfoIntegerPropertyType:

ACCOUNT_LOGIN · ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE · ACCOUNT_LEVERAGE · ACCOUNT_LIMIT_ORDERS · ACCOUNT_MARGIN_SO_MODE · ACCOUNT_TRADE_ALLOWED · ACCOUNT_TRADE_EXPERT · ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE · ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_DIGITS · ACCOUNT_FIFO_CLOSE · ACCOUNT_HEDGE_ALLOWED (11 total).

const I = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoIntegerPropertyType;
const leverage = await service.getAccountInteger(I.ACCOUNT_LEVERAGE);

docs.title: 4) getAccountString(propertyId): Promise<string>
docs.text:
One string property. Pass an AccountInfoStringPropertyType:

ACCOUNT_CURRENCY · ACCOUNT_COMPANY · ACCOUNT_NAME · ACCOUNT_SERVER (4 total).

const S = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoStringPropertyType;
const server = await service.getAccountString(S.ACCOUNT_SERVER);

docs.title: 1) Balance and equity — 6 lines → 2
docs.text:
// ❌ BEFORE (low-level) — unwrap each read
import { AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const D = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType;
const balance0 = await account.accountInfoDouble(D.ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
const equity0  = await account.accountInfoDouble(D.ACCOUNT_EQUITY);

// ✅ AFTER (mid-level) — one object
const a = await service.getAccountSummary();
console.log(`Balance: ${a.balance}, Equity: ${a.equity}`);

docs.title: 2) Margin level from the summary
docs.text:
const a = await service.getAccountSummary();
const level = a.margin > 0 ? (a.equity / a.margin) * 100 : Infinity;
console.log(`Margin level: ${level.toFixed(2)}%`);

docs.title: 3) Demo vs real guard
docs.text:
const a = await service.getAccountSummary();
if (a.tradeMode === 'DEMO')      console.log('✅ Demo — safe for testing');
else if (a.tradeMode === 'REAL') console.log('🚨 REAL account — live money!');

docs.title: 4) Dashboard line
docs.text:
const a = await service.getAccountSummary();
console.log(
  `Account ${a.login} · ${a.company} · 1:${a.leverage}\n` +
  `Balance ${a.balance.toFixed(2)} ${a.currency} · Equity ${a.equity.toFixed(2)} · Free ${a.freeMargin.toFixed(2)}`,
);

docs.title: 5) Balance monitor
docs.text:
import { AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const D = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType;

const timer = setInterval(async () => {
  try {
    const balance = await service.getAccountDouble(D.ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    console.log(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Balance: ${balance.toFixed(2)}`);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('monitor error:', (e as Error).message);
  }
}, 5000);
// later: clearInterval(timer);

docs.title: 6) Affordability check before trading
docs.text:
import { AccountInformationPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const D = AccountInformationPb.AccountInfoDoublePropertyType;

async function canOpen(requiredMargin: number): Promise<boolean> {
  const free = await service.getAccountDouble(D.ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);
  if (free < requiredMargin) {
    console.warn(`⚠️ Insufficient margin: ${free.toFixed(2)} (need ${requiredMargin.toFixed(2)})`);
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

docs.title: 🔧 When to use which
docs.text:
• Need several properties / a dashboard / a report → getAccountSummary() (already has everything).
  • Need exactly one value, or a repeated poll → getAccountDouble / Integer / String.
  • Need something the summary doesn't carry (e.g. ACCOUNT_PROFIT, SO levels, assets) → getAccountDouble(...).

docs.text: The Account methods remove protobuf ceremony: no manual requests, no .getXxx() chains, no enum imports for the common path. You get plain JS types and a single composed AccountInfo object that reads like ordinary code.

docs.title: MT5Service — Symbol Methods (Mid-Level API)
docs.text:
Quotes, symbol discovery, contract specs, sessions and price history — as plain typed objects, no protobuf.

🧩 API Layer: MID-LEVEL — a friendly facade over the low-level Symbol Information and Additional Methods groups.

Implementation: src/MT5Service.ts. Demos: examples/demos/service/04_service_demo.js.

← MT5Service Overview · low-level group ↓

docs.title: 🎯 Why these methods exist
docs.text:
On MT5Account, each symbol read means building a *Request, setting symbol + a property enum, and unwrapping *Data:

// Low-level
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setType(MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleProperty.SYMBOL_BID);
const bid = (await account.symbolInfoDouble(req)).getValue();

MT5Service collapses the common reads into one call that returns a plain value or a typed object:

// Mid-level
const tick = await service.getSymbolTick('EURUSD');   // → Quote { bid, ask, last, … }
const spec = await service.getSymbolParams('EURUSD'); // → SymbolParams (~30 fields)

docs.title: 📋 All methods
docs.text: Method Returns Purpose getSymbolsTotal(selectedOnly?) Promise<number> Count of symbols (all, or Market-Watch only). symbolExist(symbol) Promise<{ exists, isCustom }> Does a symbol exist (and is it custom)? getSymbolName(index, selectedOnly?) Promise<string> Symbol name by index. symbolSelect(symbol, select?) Promise<boolean> Add / remove from Market Watch. isSymbolSynchronized(symbol) Promise<boolean> Are the symbol's rates synced? ensureSymbol(symbol, waitMs?) Promise<Quote> Select + wait for a two-sided quote. getSymbolTick(symbol) Promise<Quote> Latest tick (the reliable price). getSymbolDouble(symbol, property) Promise<number> One SYMBOL_* double. getSymbolInteger(symbol, property) Promise<number> One SYMBOL_* integer. getSymbolString(symbol, property) Promise<string> One SYMBOL_* string. getSymbolParams(symbol) Promise<SymbolParams> Full contract spec for one symbol. getSymbolParamsMany() Promise<SymbolParams[]> Full spec for all symbols in one call. getSymbolMarginRate(symbol, orderType) Promise<SymbolMarginRate> Initial / maintenance margin rate. getSymbolSessionQuote(symbol, dayOfWeek, sessionIndex?) Promise<SessionTime> Quote-session window for a weekday. getSymbolSessionTrade(symbol, dayOfWeek, sessionIndex?) Promise<SessionTime> Trade-session window for a weekday. priceHistory(symbol, timeframe, opts?) Promise<Bar[]> OHLC bars in a range.

docs.title: Quote — from getSymbolTick / the tick stream
docs.text: Field Type Description symbol string Instrument. bid / ask / last number Best prices. volume number Tick volume. time number Tick time — milliseconds since epoch. flags number Tick flags bitmask.

docs.title: SymbolParams — from getSymbolParams / getSymbolParamsMany
docs.text: name · digits · point · bid · ask · spread · contractSize · tickSize · tickValue · volumeMin · volumeMax · volumeStep · volumeLimit · swapLong · swapShort · stopsLevel · freezeLevel · tradeMode · tradeCalcMode · tradeExeMode · fillingModes: number[] · currencyBase · currencyProfit · currencyMargin · description · path · visible · selected · exists.

docs.title: Bar — from priceHistory
docs.text: time (seconds, server tz) · open · high · low · close · tickVolume · spread · realVolume.

docs.title: Inventory & Market Watch
docs.text:
const total   = await service.getSymbolsTotal();          // all symbols
const inWatch = await service.getSymbolsTotal(true);      // Market Watch only
const first   = await service.getSymbolName(0);           // name by index
const { exists, isCustom } = await service.symbolExist('EURUSD');
const ok      = await service.symbolSelect('GBPUSD', true); // add to Market Watch
const synced  = await service.isSymbolSynchronized('EURUSD');

ensureSymbol(symbol, waitMs = 10000) — selects the symbol and polls until it has a two-sided quote (a freshly added symbol reports bid/ask = 0 until synchronized). Returns the first usable Quote. Use it before trading a symbol you just added.

docs.title: Prices
docs.text:
const tick = await service.getSymbolTick('EURUSD');
console.log(`Bid ${tick.bid}, Ask ${tick.ask}, Spread ${(tick.ask - tick.bid).toFixed(5)}`);

priceHistory(symbol, timeframe, opts?) — timeframe is a string key ('M1', 'M5', 'M15', 'M30', 'H1', 'H4', 'D1', 'W1', 'MN1', …) or the raw numeric code; opts = { from?, to?, maxBars? }:

const bars = await service.priceHistory('EURUSD', 'H1', { from: new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 3600e3), maxBars: 24 });
console.log(`${bars.length} bars, last close ${bars.at(-1)?.close}`);

docs.title: Single properties
docs.text:
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const point  = await service.getSymbolDouble('EURUSD', MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoDoubleProperty.SYMBOL_POINT);
const digits = await service.getSymbolInteger('EURUSD', MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoIntegerProperty.SYMBOL_DIGITS);
const desc   = await service.getSymbolString('EURUSD', MarketInfoPb.SymbolInfoStringProperty.SYMBOL_DESCRIPTION);

docs.title: Full contract spec
docs.text:
const s = await service.getSymbolParams('EURUSD');
console.log(`${s.name}: ${s.volumeMin}–${s.volumeMax} (step ${s.volumeStep}), contract ${s.contractSize}, digits ${s.digits}`);

const all = await service.getSymbolParamsMany(); // every symbol in one call

docs.title: Margin rate & sessions
docs.text:
const rate = await service.getSymbolMarginRate('EURUSD', 'BUY'); // OrderAction string
console.log(rate.initialMarginRate, rate.maintenanceMarginRate);

const sess = await service.getSymbolSessionTrade('EURUSD', 1);   // 1 = Monday, sessionIndex defaults to 0
console.log(`Mon trade session ${(sess.from / 3600).toFixed(2)}h → ${(sess.to / 3600).toFixed(2)}h`);

dayOfWeek: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Session from/to are seconds since midnight (server time) — divide by 3600 for the hour.

docs.title: 1) Spread right now
docs.text:
const t = await service.getSymbolTick('EURUSD');
console.log(`Spread: ${((t.ask - t.bid) / (await service.getSymbolParams('EURUSD')).point).toFixed(0)} points`);

docs.title: 2) List the Market-Watch symbols
docs.text:
const n = await service.getSymbolsTotal(true);
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) console.log(await service.getSymbolName(i, true));

docs.title: 3) Make a symbol tradable before use
docs.text:
const quote = await service.ensureSymbol('XAUUSD'); // selects + waits for a real quote
console.log('ready:', quote.bid, quote.ask);

docs.title: 4) Pre-trade sizing inputs
docs.text:
const s = await service.getSymbolParams('EURUSD');
const lots = Math.max(s.volumeMin, Math.round(0.37 / s.volumeStep) * s.volumeStep);
console.log(`Rounded lots: ${lots} (min ${s.volumeMin}, step ${s.volumeStep})`);

docs.title: 5) Daily range from bars
docs.text:
const bars = await service.priceHistory('EURUSD', 'D1', { maxBars: 1 });
const d = bars.at(-1);
if (d) console.log(`Today range: ${(d.high - d.low).toFixed(5)} (O ${d.open} C ${d.close})`);

docs.title: 6) Scan majors' spreads in one call
docs.text:
const majors = new Set(['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'USDJPY', 'AUDUSD', 'USDCAD']);
for (const s of await service.getSymbolParamsMany()) {
  if (majors.has(s.name)) console.log(`${s.name.padEnd(8)} spread ${s.spread}`);
}

docs.title: 🔧 When to use which
docs.text:
• Current price → getSymbolTick (or streamTicks for a live feed).
  • All of a symbol's spec → getSymbolParams (one symbol) / getSymbolParamsMany (all) — cheaper than many single-property reads.
  • Just one property → getSymbolDouble / Integer / String.
  • About to trade a new symbol → ensureSymbol first.
  • Charts / indicators → priceHistory.

docs.text:
• MT5Service Overview · Trading Methods · Streaming Methods.
  • Low-level: Symbol Information — Overview · Additional Methods.
  • High-level: MT5Sugar — price, spread, onTick one-liners.

docs.title: 🎯 Summary
docs.text: Symbol methods turn protobuf symbol reads into plain values and typed objects: getSymbolTick → Quote, getSymbolParams → a ~30-field SymbolParams, priceHistory → Bar[]. Discovery (getSymbolsTotal / getSymbolName / symbolExist), Market-Watch (symbolSelect / ensureSymbol), margin rates and sessions round out the group.

docs.title: MT5Service — Positions & Orders Methods (Mid-Level API)
docs.text:
The order book and the history as plain typed arrays — open positions, pending orders, closed deals and positions.

🧩 API Layer: MID-LEVEL — a facade over the low-level Positions & Orders group.

Implementation: src/MT5Service.ts. Demos: examples/demos/service/04_service_demo.js.

← MT5Service Overview · low-level group ↓

docs.title: 🎯 Why these methods exist
docs.text:
On MT5Account, reading the blotter means unwrapping repeated protobuf lists and calling a getter per field:

// Low-level
const d = await account.openedOrders();
for (const p of d.getPositionInfosList()) {
  console.log(p.getTicket(), p.getSymbol(), p.getVolume(), p.getProfit());
}

MT5Service maps each row to a plain object with named fields:

// Mid-level
const { positions } = await service.getOpenedOrders();
for (const p of positions) console.log(p.ticket, p.symbol, p.volume, p.profit);

docs.title: 📋 All methods
docs.text:
Method Returns Purpose getPositionsTotal() Promise<number> Count of open positions. getOpenedOrders() Promise<{ positions: Position[]; orders: PendingOrder[] }> Open positions and pending orders. getOpenedTickets() Promise<{ positionTickets: number[]; orderTickets: number[] }> Just the ticket numbers (lightweight). getPositions(magic?) Promise<Position[]> Open positions, optionally filtered by magic. getOrderHistory(from, to, opts?) Promise<{ orders: HistoryOrder[]; deals: HistoryDeal[] }> Closed orders + deals in a window. getPositionsHistory(from, to, opts?) Promise<HistoryPosition[]> Closed positions with P&L.

from / to accept a Date or unix-ms number; the SDK converts to the broker-server-time bounds. opts carries { sort?, page?, perPage? }.

docs.title: Position — open position
docs.text: ticket · symbol · type (0 = BUY, 1 = SELL) · volume · priceOpen · priceCurrent · stopLoss · takeProfit · swap · profit · commission · magic · comment · openTime (s) · identifier.

docs.title: PendingOrder — working order
docs.text: ticket · symbol · type · state · volumeInitial · volumeCurrent · priceOpen · priceCurrent · stopLoss · takeProfit · stopLimit · magic · comment · timeSetup · timeExpiration · positionId.

docs.title: HistoryOrder / HistoryDeal — from getOrderHistory
docs.text:
• HistoryOrder: ticket · symbol · type · state · volumeInitial · volumeCurrent · priceOpen · stopLoss · takeProfit · magic · positionId · comment · timeSetup · timeDone.
  • HistoryDeal: ticket · symbol · type (0 = BUY, 1 = SELL, 2 = BALANCE…) · entry (0 = IN, 1 = OUT, 2 = INOUT, 3 = OUT_BY) · volume · price · profit · commission · swap · fee · positionId · comment · time (s).

docs.title: HistoryPosition — from getPositionsHistory
docs.text:
ticket · symbol · type · volume · openTime · closeTime · openPrice · closePrice · stopLoss · takeProfit · profit · commission · swap · fee · magic · comment.

MT5 model: a position is net exposure; a pending order rests until triggered; a deal is an executed transaction. Realized P&L lives on deals / closed positions, not on open positions.

docs.title: 📖 Method details
docs.text:
// Count
const n = await service.getPositionsTotal();

// Full blotter
const { positions, orders } = await service.getOpenedOrders();

// Tickets only (cheap poll)
const { positionTickets, orderTickets } = await service.getOpenedTickets();

// Positions of one strategy (by magic)
const mine = await service.getPositions(123456);

// History — last 7 days
const now = new Date();
const weekAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 3600e3);

const { orders, deals } = await service.getOrderHistory(weekAgo, now, { page: 1, perPage: 100 });
const closed = await service.getPositionsHistory(weekAgo, now);

docs.title: 1) Total floating P&L
docs.text:
const { positions } = await service.getOpenedOrders();
const floating = positions.reduce((s, p) => s + p.profit + p.swap, 0);
console.log(`Floating P&L: ${floating.toFixed(2)}`);

docs.title: 2) Biggest loser right now
docs.text:
const { positions } = await service.getOpenedOrders();
const worst = positions.reduce((a, b) => (b.profit < a.profit ? b : a), positions[0]);
if (worst) console.log(`Worst: #${worst.ticket} ${worst.symbol} ${worst.profit.toFixed(2)}`);

docs.title: 3) Lightweight "anything open?" poll
docs.text:
const { positionTickets, orderTickets } = await service.getOpenedTickets();
console.log(positionTickets.length === 0 && orderTickets.length === 0 ? 'flat' : 'in the market');

docs.title: 4) Per-strategy exposure by magic
docs.text:
const mine = await service.getPositions(777);
const net = mine.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.type === 0 ? p.volume : -p.volume), 0);
console.log(`Strategy 777 net volume: ${net}`);

docs.title: 5) Realized P&L today
docs.text:
const now = new Date();
const start = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
const closed = await service.getPositionsHistory(start, now);
console.log(`Realized today: ${closed.reduce((s, p) => s + p.profit, 0).toFixed(2)} over ${closed.length} positions`);

docs.title: 6) Deals of a single position
docs.text:
const { deals } = await service.getOrderHistory(new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 3600e3), new Date());
const posId = 123456;
for (const d of deals.filter((x) => x.positionId === posId)) {
  console.log(`${d.entry === 0 ? 'IN ' : 'OUT'} ${d.volume} @ ${d.price} → ${d.profit}`);
}

docs.title: 🔧 When to use which
docs.text:
• Just a count → getPositionsTotal.
  • Full detail of what's open → getOpenedOrders (positions + pending) or getPositions (positions, magic-filtered).
  • Cheap change-detection loop → getOpenedTickets.
  • What closed and for how much → getPositionsHistory (per closed position) or getOrderHistory (raw orders + deals).

docs.title: 🎯 Summary
docs.text: Positions & Orders methods return plain typed arrays instead of repeated protobuf lists: Position[], PendingOrder[], HistoryOrder[] / HistoryDeal[], HistoryPosition[]. Date goes in, named fields come out, and magic / paging keep large result sets manageable.

docs.title: MT5Service — Trading Methods (Mid-Level API)
docs.text:
Place, modify, close, validate and size trades with plain argument objects and string order actions — no protobuf, no enum imports.

🧩 API Layer: MID-LEVEL — a facade over the low-level Trading Operations group.

Implementation: src/MT5Service.ts. Demos: examples/demos/service/04_service_demo.js.

← MT5Service Overview · low-level group ↓

docs.title: 🎯 Why these methods exist
docs.text:
On MT5Account, sending an order means building a protobuf request, setting the operation enum, and each optional field by setter:

// Low-level
import { TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperation(TradingHelperPb.TMT5_ENUM_ORDER_TYPE.TMT5_ORDER_TYPE_BUY);
req.setVolume(0.1);
req.setStopLoss(1.08);
const d = await account.orderSend(req);
if (d.getReturnedCode() === 10009) { /* … */ }

MT5Service takes a plain object with a string action and returns a typed OrderResult:

// Mid-level
const r = await service.placeOrder({ symbol: 'EURUSD', action: 'BUY', volume: 0.1, stopLoss: 1.08 });
if (r.retcode === 10009) console.log('filled, ticket', r.ticket);

docs.title: 🛑 The trade retcode
docs.text:
MT5 trades carry a trade-server return code. 10009 = DONE (success). placeOrder / modifyOrder / closeOrder reject the promise only on an API/transport error; a broker rejection comes back in the result as a non-10009 retcode. Always check it.

Common codes: 10009 DONE · 10004 REQUOTE · 10006 REJECTED · 10013 INVALID · 10014 INVALID_VOLUME · 10015 INVALID_PRICE · 10016 INVALID_STOPS · 10018 MARKET_CLOSED · 10019 NO_MONEY. See Return Codes.

docs.title: 📋 All methods
docs.text:
Method Returns Purpose placeOrder(req: OrderRequest) Promise<OrderResult> Send a market or pending order. modifyOrder(req: ModifyRequest) Promise<OrderResult> Change SL/TP (and price/expiration for pendings). closeOrder(req: CloseRequest) Promise<CloseResult> Close a position (full/partial) or delete a pending. checkOrder(req) Promise<OrderCheckResult> Validate before sending (margin, free margin after deal…). calculateMargin(action, symbol, volume, price) Promise<number> Required margin for a prospective order. calculateProfit(action, symbol, volume, openPrice, closePrice) Promise<number> Profit of a prospective trade.

action: OrderAction is one of 'BUY' · 'SELL' · 'BUY_LIMIT' · 'SELL_LIMIT' · 'BUY_STOP' · 'SELL_STOP' · 'BUY_STOP_LIMIT' · 'SELL_STOP_LIMIT'.

docs.title: OrderRequest (→ placeOrder)
docs.text: Field Type Notes symbol string Instrument. required action OrderAction Order type (string). required volume number Lots. required price? number Entry price (pending; market uses the live quote). stopLoss? / takeProfit? number Protective levels. slippage? number Max deviation (points). comment? string Free-text tag. magic? number Expert id — needed for per-strategy filtering. stopLimitPrice? number For stop-limit orders. expirationTimeType? / expirationTime? number / Date Pending-order expiry. quotesWaitMs? number How long to wait for the first quote (default 5000).

docs.title: OrderResult (← placeOrder / modifyOrder)
docs.text: ticket (= position ticket for a filled market order) · retcode · retcodeDescription · deal · order · volume · price · bid · ask · comment · requestId.

docs.title: OrderCheckResult (← checkOrder)
docs.text: returnedCode (0 = would be accepted) · balance · equity · profit · margin · marginFree · marginLevel · comment.

docs.title: 📖 Method details
docs.text:
// Market BUY with SL/TP
const r = await service.placeOrder({ symbol: 'EURUSD', action: 'BUY', volume: 0.1, stopLoss: 1.08, takeProfit: 1.09 });

// Modify SL/TP
await service.modifyOrder({ ticket: r.ticket, stopLoss: 1.082, takeProfit: 1.095 });

// Close (full)
const c = await service.closeOrder({ ticket: r.ticket });

// Validate first (0 = ok)
const chk = await service.checkOrder({ symbol: 'EURUSD', action: 'BUY', volume: 0.1 });

// Sizing calculators
const margin = await service.calculateMargin('BUY', 'EURUSD', 1.0, 1.085);
const profit = await service.calculateProfit('BUY', 'EURUSD', 0.1, 1.085, 1.090);

docs.title: 1) Place and confirm
docs.text:
const r = await service.placeOrder({ symbol: 'EURUSD', action: 'BUY', volume: 0.1 });
if (r.retcode === 10009) console.log(`✅ Filled, ticket #${r.ticket} @ ${r.price}`);
else console.log(`❌ Rejected: ${r.retcodeDescription} (code ${r.retcode})`);

docs.title: 2) Affordability before sending
docs.text:
const margin = await service.calculateMargin('BUY', 'EURUSD', 1.0, (await service.getSymbolTick('EURUSD')).ask);
const a = await service.getAccountSummary();
console.log(margin <= a.freeMargin ? '✅ affordable' : `❌ need ${margin.toFixed(2)}, free ${a.freeMargin.toFixed(2)}`);

docs.title: 3) Validate → send
docs.text:
const chk = await service.checkOrder({ symbol: 'EURUSD', action: 'BUY', volume: 0.1 });
if (chk.returnedCode !== 0) throw new Error(`check failed: ${chk.comment}`);
const r = await service.placeOrder({ symbol: 'EURUSD', action: 'BUY', volume: 0.1 });

docs.title: 4) Partial close (half)
docs.text:
const { positions } = await service.getOpenedOrders();
const p = positions[0];
if (p) await service.closeOrder({ ticket: p.ticket, volume: p.volume / 2 });

docs.title: 5) Move stop to break-even
docs.text:
const { positions } = await service.getOpenedOrders();
for (const p of positions) {
  if (p.type === 0 && p.priceCurrent > p.priceOpen) { // BUY in profit
    await service.modifyOrder({ ticket: p.ticket, stopLoss: p.priceOpen });
  }
}

docs.title: 6) Risk/reward estimate before entry
docs.text:
const entry = (await service.getSymbolTick('EURUSD')).ask;
const risk   = await service.calculateProfit('BUY', 'EURUSD', 0.1, entry, entry - 0.0020); // -20 pips
const reward = await service.calculateProfit('BUY', 'EURUSD', 0.1, entry, entry + 0.0040); // +40 pips
console.log(`R:R ≈ 1:${(Math.abs(reward / risk)).toFixed(1)}`);

docs.title: 🔧 When to use which
docs.text:
• Open a trade → placeOrder (always check retcode === 10009).
  • Adjust SL/TP → modifyOrder.
  • Close / partial-close → closeOrder.
  • Dry-run before sending → checkOrder (returnedCode === 0).
  • Size the trade → calculateMargin / calculateProfit.

docs.text:
